q.en: Talking loudly during the exam is completely unacceptable.
q.zh: 考試時大聲說話是完全不可接受的。

q.en: Please check the accuracy of your answers before handing in the test.
q.zh: 交卷之前請檢查你答案的正確性。

q.en: Winning the speech contest was a great achievement for Amy.
q.zh: 贏得演講比賽對Amy來說是一項很大的成就。

q.en: In addition to math, Ben takes extra English classes after school.
q.zh: 除了數學之外，Ben放學後還要上額外的英文課。

q.en: Everyone has great admiration for Mr. Chen's patience with students.
q.zh: 大家都非常欽佩Mr. Chen對學生的耐心。

q.en: Please tell me in advance if you cannot come to practice.
q.zh: 如果你不能來練習，請事先告訴我。

q.en: The only disadvantage of this apartment is that it is far from school.
q.zh: 這間公寓唯一的缺點就是離學校很遠。

q.en: Lisa is an adventurous girl who loves hiking in the mountains.
q.zh: Lisa是個愛冒險的女孩，喜歡在山裡健行。

q.en: I saw an advertisement for a new bubble tea shop on the bus.
q.zh: 我在公車上看到一家新開的珍珠奶茶店的廣告。

q.en: Mr. Chen gave us some useful advice about preparing for the exam.
q.zh: Mr. Chen給了我們一些準備考試的實用建議。

q.en: Our teacher will advise us which university to apply to this year.
q.zh: 我們的老師會建議我們今年該申請哪一所大學。

q.en: Kevin is looking for an affordable laptop for school.
q.zh: Kevin正在找一台學校用、價格負擔得起的筆電。

q.en: Taiwan exports many agricultural products such as fruit and tea to other countries.
q.zh: 台灣出口許多農產品，例如水果和茶葉到其他國家。

q.en: The names on the list are in alphabetical order.
q.zh: 名單上的名字是依字母順序排列的。

q.en: Everyone in the classroom watched the magic show in amazement.
q.zh: 教室裡的每個人都驚奇地看著魔術表演。

q.en: Lisa is an ambitious student who wants to study medicine abroad.
q.zh: Lisa是個有抱負的學生，想去國外學醫。

q.en: The principal made an important announcement about the school trip this morning.
q.zh: 校長今天早上宣布了一項關於校外教學的重要公告。

q.en: Kevin felt great anxiety before the English speech contest.
q.zh: 英語演講比賽前，Kevin感到非常焦慮。

q.en: Ben made a sincere apology to his teacher for being late.
q.zh: Ben為遲到向老師誠懇地道歉。

q.en: The cute cartoon characters are very appealing to young children.
q.zh: 這些可愛的卡通角色對小朋友很有吸引力。

q.en: Amy's parents gave their approval to her plan to study abroad.
q.zh: Amy的父母同意了她出國讀書的計畫。

q.en: Thank you for your assistance with the school festival last week.
q.zh: 謝謝你上週對校慶的協助。

q.en: Could you assist me with carrying these heavy boxes to the classroom?
q.zh: 你可以幫我把這些重箱子搬到教室嗎？

q.en: Don't make the assumption that the test will be easy.
q.zh: 不要假設這次考試會很簡單。

q.en: Ben is very athletic and plays basketball every afternoon.
q.zh: Ben很愛運動，每天下午都打籃球。

q.en: The night market is a popular tourist attraction in Taipei.
q.zh: 夜市是台北很受歡迎的觀光景點。

q.en: Bright colors often attract the attention of small children.
q.zh: 鮮豔的顏色常常吸引小孩子的注意。

q.en: The door opens automatically when you walk up to it.
q.zh: 當你走近時，門會自動打開。

q.en: The bright morning sun began to awaken the sleepy town.
q.zh: 明亮的晨光開始喚醒這個昏昏欲睡的小鎮。

q.en: Kevin stayed awake all night to finish his science report.
q.zh: Kevin整晚沒睡，只為了完成他的自然科報告。

q.en: Public awareness of recycling has grown a lot in recent years.
q.zh: 近年來大眾對資源回收的意識提高了許多。

q.en: It is awfully cold this morning, so wear your jacket.
q.zh: 今天早上冷得要命，所以要穿外套。

q.en: Ben stood awkwardly at the door because he did not know anyone.
q.zh: Ben尷尬地站在門口，因為他一個人也不認識。

q.en: The milk smells bad, so please do not drink it.
q.zh: 這牛奶聞起來壞掉了，所以請不要喝。

q.en: Amy opened a bank account to save her pocket money.
q.zh: Amy開了一個銀行帳戶來存零用錢。

q.en: Kevin could barely keep his eyes open during the long lecture.
q.zh: 在那場冗長的演講中，Kevin幾乎睜不開眼睛。

q.en: The kids ran on the beach in their bare feet.
q.zh: 孩子們光著腳在沙灘上跑。

q.en: Eating more vegetables is beneficial to your health.
q.zh: 多吃蔬菜對你的健康有益。

q.en: Lisa sat beside her best friend on the school bus.
q.zh: Lisa坐在她最好的朋友旁邊搭校車。

q.en: The wind was bitterly cold when we left school today.
q.zh: 今天我們離開學校時，風冷得刺骨。

q.en: Mr. Chen donates blood at the hospital twice a year.
q.zh: Mr. Chen一年到醫院捐兩次血。

q.en: Good health is a great blessing for the whole family.
q.zh: 健康對全家人來說是很大的福氣。

q.en: The nurse took a sample of Amy's blood for the test.
q.zh: 護理師抽取了Amy的血液樣本來做檢驗。

q.en: Kevin boldly raised his hand and asked the teacher a question.
q.zh: Kevin大膽地舉手向老師提問。

q.en: Lisa was bored during the long speech, so she looked out the window.
q.zh: 冗長的演講讓Lisa覺得無聊，所以她望向窗外。

q.en: Ben was brave enough to speak in front of the whole school.
q.zh: Ben很勇敢，敢在全校面前演講。

q.en: Please breathe deeply and relax before the big exam begins.
q.zh: 大考開始前，請深呼吸放輕鬆。

q.en: Amy took a deep breath before she walked onto the stage.
q.zh: Amy上台前深吸了一口氣。

q.en: It is a breezy afternoon, so let's fly kites in the park.
q.zh: 今天下午微風徐徐，我們去公園放風箏吧。

q.en: The bus ride was bumpy because the road was under repair.
q.zh: 因為道路在整修，公車坐起來很顛簸。

q.en: Our new computer has the capability to run many programs at once.
q.zh: 我們的新電腦有能力同時執行許多程式。

q.en: Kevin was casually dressed in jeans and a T-shirt at the party.
q.zh: Kevin在派對上穿著牛仔褲和T恤，打扮很休閒。

q.en: Our school team won the basketball championship last month.
q.zh: 我們學校的隊伍上個月贏得了籃球賽冠軍。

q.en: Lisa lives in a charming little house near the river.
q.zh: Lisa住在河邊一間迷人的小房子裡。

q.en: The students sang cheerfully on the bus to the museum.
q.zh: 學生們在前往博物館的公車上愉快地唱歌。

q.en: It gets chilly at night in the mountains, so bring a coat.
q.zh: 山上晚上會變冷，所以要帶外套。

q.en: There was a chill in the air as winter came closer.
q.zh: 隨著冬天接近，空氣中有了寒意。

q.en: Amy took a class on citizenship to learn about her rights.
q.zh: Amy上了一堂公民課來了解自己的權利。

q.en: The ancient Egyptian civilization built huge pyramids along the Nile.
q.zh: 古埃及文明在尼羅河沿岸建造了巨大的金字塔。

q.en: Please clean the blackboard before the next class begins.
q.zh: 下一堂課開始前，請把黑板擦乾淨。

q.en: Lisa packed warm clothing for the school trip to the mountains.
q.zh: Lisa為去山上的校外教學打包了保暖衣物。

q.en: Ben likes to collect stamps from different countries.
q.zh: Ben喜歡收集來自不同國家的郵票。

q.en: What color do you want to paint your bedroom walls?
q.zh: 你想把臥室的牆壁漆成什麼顏色？

q.en: These new sofas in the classroom are really comfortable.
q.zh: 教室裡這些新沙發真的很舒服。

q.en: Good communication is the key to working well in a team.
q.zh: 良好的溝通是團隊合作順利的關鍵。

q.en: Amy likes to compare prices before she buys anything online.
q.zh: Amy在網路上買東西之前喜歡先比價。

q.en: Over fifty students joined the singing competition at our school.
q.zh: 我們學校有五十多位學生參加了歌唱比賽。

q.en: Lisa made a complaint about the noisy neighbors upstairs.
q.zh: Lisa投訴樓上吵鬧的鄰居。

q.en: Kevin likes to complain about the long walk from the station.
q.zh: Kevin老是抱怨從車站走過來的路太長。

q.en: Ben will conclude his speech with a short story.
q.zh: Ben會用一個小故事來結束他的演講。

q.en: Ben received a confirmation email after he booked the concert tickets.
q.zh: Ben訂了演唱會門票後，收到了一封確認信。

q.en: The test instructions were confusing, so many students made mistakes.
q.zh: 考試說明讓人搞不清楚，所以很多學生都寫錯了。

q.en: The hotel has a good Internet connection in every room.
q.zh: 這間旅館每個房間的網路連線都很好。

q.en: The runner fell down and was unconscious for a few minutes.
q.zh: 那位跑者跌倒後昏迷了幾分鐘。

q.en: The new subway line has made our trip considerably shorter.
q.zh: 新的捷運線讓我們的旅程縮短了許多。

q.en: My little brother constantly asks me to play games with him.
q.zh: 我弟弟不停地要我跟他玩遊戲。

q.en: A good leader knows how to control his temper.
q.zh: 好的領導者懂得控制自己的脾氣。

q.en: My grandmother likes to cook dumplings on weekends.
q.zh: 我奶奶週末喜歡煮水餃。

q.en: The cost of living in big cities keeps going up.
q.zh: 大城市的生活費用不斷上漲。

q.en: Can you count how many students are in the gym?
q.zh: 你能數一數體育館裡有多少學生嗎？

q.en: Amy showed great creativity in her art project for the school fair.
q.zh: Amy在園遊會的美術作品中展現了很大的創意。

q.en: Amy's latest creation is a dress made from old newspapers.
q.zh: Amy最新的作品是一件用舊報紙做成的洋裝。

q.en: The police are working hard to reduce crime in our neighborhood.
q.zh: 警方正努力減少我們社區的犯罪。

q.en: Animal cruelty is against the law in many countries.
q.zh: 虐待動物在許多國家都是違法的。

q.en: Kevin has to deal with a lot of homework this week.
q.zh: Kevin這星期有很多作業要處理。

q.en: Lisa hung a paper decoration on the classroom door for the party.
q.zh: Lisa為了派對在教室門上掛了一個紙做的裝飾。

q.en: The number of students in our school will increase next year.
q.zh: 明年我們學校的學生人數會增加。

q.en: The river is very deep, so do not swim here.
q.zh: 這條河很深，所以不要在這裡游泳。

q.en: Can you define this word in your own words?
q.zh: 你能用自己的話替這個字下定義嗎？

q.en: Taiwan is a democratic country with free elections.
q.zh: 台灣是一個有自由選舉的民主國家。

q.en: Students learn about democracy in their civics class.
q.zh: 學生在公民課上學習民主。

q.en: Amy wants to design a poster for the school concert.
q.zh: Amy想為學校的音樂會設計一張海報。

q.en: Ben has a strong desire to travel around the world.
q.zh: Ben非常渴望環遊世界。

q.en: A quiet room is desirable for studying before exams.
q.zh: 考前讀書最好有一間安靜的房間。

q.en: The typhoon caused great destruction to the small fishing village.
q.zh: 颱風對這個小漁村造成了嚴重的破壞。

q.en: The detective carefully looked for clues at the scene.
q.zh: 偵探仔細地在現場尋找線索。

q.en: Lisa's strong determination helped her finish the marathon.
q.zh: Lisa堅定的決心幫助她跑完了馬拉松。

q.en: My family usually eats dinner at seven o'clock.
q.zh: 我們家通常七點吃晚餐。

q.en: Your shoes are dirty, so please take them off.
q.zh: 你的鞋子很髒，所以請脫掉。

q.en: A good friend is always honest with you.
q.zh: 好朋友總是對你很誠實。

q.en: The diver found an old ship under the sea.
q.zh: 潛水員在海底發現了一艘舊船。

q.en: Lisa felt a little dizziness after standing up too fast.
q.zh: Lisa太快站起來後覺得有點頭暈。

q.en: I have no doubt that Amy will win the speech contest.
q.zh: 我毫不懷疑Amy會贏得演講比賽。

q.en: Amy joined the drama club because she loves acting on stage.
q.zh: Amy加入了戲劇社，因為她喜歡在舞台上表演。

q.en: The old books in the attic were very dusty.
q.zh: 閣樓裡的舊書積滿了灰塵。

q.en: The students waited eagerly for the winner to be announced.
q.zh: 學生們熱切地等待得獎者公布。

q.en: This new edition of the dictionary has many more example sentences.
q.zh: 這本字典的新版多了許多例句。

q.en: Lisa will edit the school newspaper this semester.
q.zh: Lisa這學期要編輯校刊。

q.en: Good education gives every child a chance to build a better future.
q.zh: 好的教育讓每個孩子都有機會創造更好的未來。

q.en: Ben wants to get a good education at a famous university.
q.zh: Ben想在一所知名大學接受良好的教育。

q.en: Kevin finished his homework efficiently by making a list first.
q.zh: Kevin先列清單，有效率地完成了作業。

q.en: Our class will hold an election for class leader tomorrow.
q.zh: 我們班明天要舉行班長選舉。

q.en: Students will elect a new president for the student council.
q.zh: 學生們將選出學生會的新會長。

q.en: The electric bike is cheap and easy to use.
q.zh: 這台電動腳踏車又便宜又好用。

q.en: Ben likes to repair old electronics in his free time.
q.zh: Ben空閒時喜歡修理舊的電子產品。

q.en: Amy could not hide her emotion when she read the letter.
q.zh: Amy讀信時無法掩飾她的情緒。

q.en: Kevin is unable to come to class because he has a fever.
q.zh: Kevin發燒了，所以無法來上課。

q.en: Children have so much energy that they never want to sleep.
q.zh: 小孩子精力旺盛，一點也不想睡覺。

q.en: Lisa will enjoy the school trip to the science museum.
q.zh: Lisa會喜歡這趟到科學博物館的校外教學。

q.en: Please enter the classroom quietly when the lesson has begun.
q.zh: 上課後進教室時請安靜。

q.en: Ben felt envious when he saw Kevin's new bicycle.
q.zh: Ben看到Kevin的新腳踏車時覺得很羨慕。

q.en: Can I borrow your eraser to fix my mistake?
q.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦來改正我的錯誤嗎？

q.en: Amy got an excellent score on the English exam.
q.zh: Amy在英文考試中得到了很棒的成績。

q.en: The museum will exhibit paintings by local students next week.
q.zh: 博物館下週將展出本地學生的畫作。

q.en: Kevin did not expect to see his teacher at the night market.
q.zh: Kevin沒想到會在夜市遇到他的老師。

q.en: We heard a loud explosion from the construction site.
q.zh: 我們聽到工地傳來一聲巨大的爆炸聲。

q.en: The young explorer spent years studying the rainforest.
q.zh: 這位年輕的探險家花了多年研究雨林。

q.en: Taiwan has to import most of its oil from other countries.
q.zh: 台灣必須從其他國家進口大部分的石油。

q.en: Mr. Chen's face had a happy expression as he read the news.
q.zh: Mr. Chen讀到那則消息時，臉上露出開心的表情。

q.en: The final exam was extremely difficult for most of the students.
q.zh: 這次期末考對大多數學生來說都極度困難。

q.en: It is not fair to give one team more time.
q.zh: 給其中一隊比較多時間是不公平的。

q.en: My dog is faithful and always waits for me at the gate.
q.zh: 我的狗很忠心，總是在門口等我。

q.en: Ben felt lost in the unfamiliar city on his first day.
q.zh: Ben第一天在陌生的城市裡覺得迷路了。

q.en: How far is the train station from your house?
q.zh: 火車站離你家有多遠？

q.en: Amy loves to read magazines about fashion and style.
q.zh: Amy喜歡看關於時尚和風格的雜誌。

q.en: Kevin felt fear as the roller coaster climbed higher.
q.zh: 雲霄飛車往上爬升時，Kevin感到害怕。

q.en: Eating healthy food helps your body fight against illness.
q.zh: 吃健康的食物能幫助你的身體對抗疾病。

q.en: A thick fog covered the city this morning.
q.zh: 今天早上濃霧籠罩了整座城市。

q.en: Please follow the teacher to the science lab.
q.zh: 請跟著老師到自然科實驗室。

q.en: Amy was fortunate to find her lost wallet at the bus stop.
q.zh: Amy很幸運，在公車站找到了她弄丟的錢包。

q.en: Lisa bought a pack of frozen dumplings from the supermarket.
q.zh: Lisa在超市買了一包冷凍水餃。

q.en: The pond will freeze if the weather stays this cold.
q.zh: 如果天氣一直這麼冷，池塘就會結冰。

q.en: Ben frequently visits the library after school to read books.
q.zh: Ben放學後經常去圖書館看書。

q.en: The movie was so frightening that Lisa closed her eyes.
q.zh: 那部電影太可怕了，Lisa把眼睛閉了起來。

q.en: Amy was frightened by the loud thunder last night.
q.zh: 昨晚的大雷聲把Amy嚇壞了。

q.en: Lisa loves petting her neighbor's furry white cat.
q.zh: Lisa喜歡摸鄰居那隻毛茸茸的白貓。

q.en: Mr. Chen showed us a geographical map of Taiwan.
q.zh: Mr. Chen給我們看了一張台灣的地理地圖。

q.en: Ben pointed to Taiwan on the globe in the classroom.
q.zh: Ben在教室的地球儀上指出台灣的位置。

q.en: We had a glorious sunny day for the school sports meet.
q.zh: 我們的運動會碰上了一個陽光燦爛的好天氣。

q.en: The government plans to build more bike paths in the city.
q.zh: 政府計畫在市區興建更多自行車道。

q.en: Amy's family will attend her graduation on Friday morning.
q.zh: Amy的家人星期五早上會參加她的畢業典禮。

q.en: Kevin lay on the grass and watched the clouds.
q.zh: Kevin躺在草地上看著雲。

q.en: The man's greed made him want more and more money.
q.zh: 這個人的貪婪讓他想要越來越多的錢。

q.en: Mom went to the market to buy groceries for dinner.
q.zh: 媽媽去市場買晚餐要用的食材。

q.en: Our tour guide told us many interesting stories about the museum.
q.zh: 我們的導遊告訴了我們許多關於這間博物館的有趣故事。

q.en: Eating too much sugar is harmful to your teeth.
q.zh: 吃太多糖對你的牙齒有害。

q.en: These small insects are harmless, so don't be afraid.
q.zh: 這些小昆蟲是無害的，所以不要害怕。

q.en: Ben hastily packed his bag and ran out to catch the bus.
q.zh: 班匆匆收拾書包，跑出去趕公車。

q.en: Amy felt no hatred toward her classmate, even after the argument.
q.zh: 即使在爭吵之後，艾美對她的同學也沒有任何恨意。

q.en: The heat from the sun made everyone in the class feel sleepy.
q.zh: 太陽的熱氣讓班上每個人都昏昏欲睡。

q.en: Lisa answered without hesitation because she knew the answer well.
q.zh: 麗莎毫不猶豫地回答，因為她很清楚答案。

q.en: Mr. Chen teaches world history at our school every Monday morning.
q.zh: 陳老師每週一早上在我們學校教世界歷史。

q.en: Amy enjoys reading historical novels about ancient China.
q.zh: 艾美喜歡閱讀以中國古代為背景的歷史小說。

q.en: Please hold the ladder while I change the light bulb.
q.zh: 我換燈泡的時候，請你扶住梯子。

q.en: Kevin suffered from homesickness on his first night at the dormitory.
q.zh: 凱文在宿舍的第一晚飽受思鄉之苦。

q.en: Amy is an honest girl who always returns lost money.
q.zh: 艾美是個誠實的女孩，總是把撿到的錢歸還。

q.en: It is an honorable job to help people in need.
q.zh: 幫助有需要的人是一份光榮的工作。

q.en: Ben felt hopeless after failing the math test three times.
q.zh: 班的數學考試連續三次不及格，讓他感到絕望。

q.en: Lisa screamed in horror when she saw a big spider.
q.zh: 麗莎看到一隻大蜘蛛時嚇得尖叫。

q.en: The food in the cafeteria smelled horrible today, so Amy skipped lunch.
q.zh: 今天餐廳的食物聞起來很糟，所以艾美沒吃午餐。

q.en: It takes about an hour to walk from my house to school.
q.zh: 從我家走路到學校大約要一個小時。

q.en: The humidity in Taipei is very high in summer.
q.zh: 台北夏天的濕度非常高。

q.en: Mr. Chen is so humorous that his students love his class.
q.zh: 陳老師非常幽默，所以學生都喜歡上他的課。

q.en: Kevin has a good sense of humor, so he makes everyone laugh.
q.zh: 凱文很有幽默感，所以他總是逗得大家哈哈大笑。

q.en: I was so hungry after basketball practice that I ate two lunch boxes.
q.zh: 籃球練習之後我餓壞了，吃了兩個便當。

q.en: Be careful when you walk on the ice near the lake.
q.zh: 在湖邊的冰上走路要小心。

q.en: Amy is an imaginative girl who writes wonderful stories for the school magazine.
q.zh: 艾美是個很有想像力的女孩，為校刊寫了很棒的故事。

q.en: When the bell rang, the students immediately walked into the classroom.
q.zh: 鐘聲一響，學生們立刻走進教室。

q.en: Lisa gave an impressive speech at the English contest yesterday.
q.zh: 麗莎昨天在英語比賽中發表了一場令人印象深刻的演講。

q.en: It rained heavily, so we had to play basketball indoors.
q.zh: 雨下得很大，所以我們只好在室內打籃球。

q.en: Our school has a new indoor swimming pool for students.
q.zh: 我們學校有一座新的室內游泳池給學生使用。

q.en: Taiwan's computer industry is famous around the world.
q.zh: 台灣的電腦產業聞名全世界。

q.en: Amy felt a sense of inferiority when she saw her classmate's perfect score.
q.zh: 艾美看到同學的滿分成績時，心裡感到自卑。

q.en: Please give me more information about the school trip to Hualien.
q.zh: 請給我更多關於花蓮校外教學的資訊。

q.en: Please inform your parents about the meeting on Friday afternoon.
q.zh: 請通知你的父母星期五下午的會議。

q.en: The injured player was carried off the basketball court by his teammates.
q.zh: 受傷的球員被隊友抬離籃球場。

q.en: Kevin wore a warm outer coat over his school uniform.
q.zh: 凱文在制服外面穿了一件保暖的外套。

q.en: The little girl's innocence made everyone in the classroom smile.
q.zh: 小女孩的天真讓教室裡的每個人都笑了。

q.en: The teacher made a careful inspection of our science projects.
q.zh: 老師仔細檢查了我們的科學作品。

q.en: Mr. Chen will inspect every desk before we leave the classroom.
q.zh: 在我們離開教室之前，陳老師會檢查每張桌子。

q.en: Hard work is often more important than natural intelligence in school.
q.zh: 在學校裡，努力往往比天生的聰明才智更重要。

q.en: Sorry for the interruption, but the principal wants to see you now.
q.zh: 抱歉打斷一下，校長現在要見你。

q.en: The invention of the light bulb changed people's lives a lot.
q.zh: 電燈泡的發明大大改變了人們的生活。

q.en: Lisa wants to invent a robot that can clean her room.
q.zh: 麗莎想發明一台能打掃她房間的機器人。

q.en: The police started an investigation after the bike was stolen.
q.zh: 腳踏車被偷之後，警方展開了調查。

q.en: Amy decided to invite all her classmates to her birthday party.
q.zh: 艾美決定邀請所有同學來參加她的生日派對。

q.en: Ben could not hide his jealousy when Kevin won the first prize.
q.zh: 凱文得到第一名時，班藏不住心裡的忌妒。

q.en: Lisa's grandmother keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
q.zh: 麗莎的奶奶把她的珠寶收在一個小木盒裡。

q.en: The ring has a bright blue jewel in the center.
q.zh: 這只戒指中間有一顆亮藍色的寶石。

q.en: The students jumped for joy when they heard the good news.
q.zh: 學生們聽到好消息時高興得跳了起來。

q.en: Amy drinks a glass of orange juice every morning.
q.zh: 艾美每天早上都喝一杯柳橙汁。

q.en: In the story, the king gave his daughter a beautiful horse.
q.zh: 故事裡，國王送給他女兒一匹美麗的馬。

q.en: My grandmother enjoys knitting while she watches TV in the evening.
q.zh: 我奶奶晚上喜歡一邊看電視一邊編織。

q.en: Kevin was late for school because he missed the bus.
q.zh: 凱文因為錯過公車而上學遲到。

q.en: Amy likes to laugh at Mr. Chen's funny jokes in class.
q.zh: 艾美喜歡在課堂上對陳老師的笑話哈哈大笑。

q.en: Kevin wants to learn how to play the guitar this summer.
q.zh: 凱文今年夏天想學彈吉他。

q.en: We took a leisurely walk along the river after dinner.
q.zh: 晚餐後我們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。

q.en: Lisa put a slice of lemon in her cold tea.
q.zh: 麗莎在她的冷茶裡放了一片檸檬。

q.en: My parents are quite liberal, so they let me choose my own clubs.
q.zh: 我爸媽很開明，所以讓我自己選擇社團。

q.en: Grandpa has lived a long and happy life in the countryside.
q.zh: 爺爺在鄉下過著漫長又快樂的生活。

q.en: The school's location near the station is very convenient for students.
q.zh: 學校靠近車站的位置對學生來說非常方便。

q.en: Can you help me locate the nearest bookstore on this map?
q.zh: 你可以幫我在這張地圖上找出最近的書店嗎？

q.en: Ben put his gym clothes in his locker before class.
q.zh: 班上課前把他的運動服放進置物櫃。

q.en: Please loosen your tie if you feel too hot in the classroom.
q.zh: 如果你在教室裡覺得太熱，請把領帶鬆開。

q.en: Our team did not want to lose the final basketball game.
q.zh: 我們隊不想輸掉籃球決賽。

q.en: Amy has a great love for music and plays the piano well.
q.zh: 艾美非常熱愛音樂，鋼琴也彈得很好。

q.en: The little boy was surprised by the magic show at the school party.
q.zh: 小男孩被校園派對上的魔術表演嚇了一跳。

q.en: Kevin learned a card trick, and his friends thought it was pure magic.
q.zh: 凱文學會了一個紙牌戲法，他的朋友們覺得簡直是魔術。

q.en: The teacher used a magnetic board to show the science experiment.
q.zh: 老師用磁性白板來展示科學實驗。

q.en: Rice is a major crop in many Asian countries.
q.zh: 稻米是許多亞洲國家的主要作物。

q.en: Amy is good at mathematics and wants to study it in college.
q.zh: 艾美擅長數學，想在大學主修數學。

q.en: Kevin thought the long speech was meaningless and boring.
q.zh: 凱文覺得那場冗長的演講毫無意義又無聊。

q.en: Exercise helps students stay mentally healthy during exam weeks.
q.zh: 運動能幫助學生在考試週保持心理健康。

q.en: Ben's desk is so messy that he cannot find his pen.
q.zh: 班的書桌太亂了，他找不到他的筆。

q.en: Her recovery was almost miraculous, and the doctors were very surprised.
q.zh: 她的康復幾乎像奇蹟一樣，醫生們都非常驚訝。

q.en: Kevin felt miserable when he lost his phone on the train.
q.zh: 凱文在火車上弄丟手機時覺得很難過。

q.en: Don't miss the last bus, or you will have to walk home.
q.zh: 別錯過最後一班公車，否則你得走路回家。

q.en: It was a misty morning, so we could not see the mountain.
q.zh: 那天早上起了霧，所以我們看不到山。

q.en: Plants need enough moisture to grow well in the dry season.
q.zh: 植物在乾季需要足夠的水分才能長得好。

q.en: Mom made a moist chocolate cake for my birthday.
q.zh: 媽媽為我的生日做了一個濕潤的巧克力蛋糕。

q.en: Our class has a meeting once a month to plan activities.
q.zh: 我們班每個月開一次會來規劃活動。

q.en: Mr. Chen often talks about kindness and morality in his class.
q.zh: 陳老師常在課堂上談論善良與道德。

q.en: Kevin spends most of his weekends at the library with friends.
q.zh: 凱文大部分的週末都和朋友待在圖書館。

q.en: Kevin's father rides a motorcycle to work every day.
q.zh: 凱文的爸爸每天騎機車上班。

q.en: Lisa finds multiplication easier than division in math class.
q.zh: 麗莎覺得數學課裡乘法比除法簡單。

q.en: The muscular boy lifted the heavy box easily.
q.zh: 那個肌肉結實的男孩輕鬆地抬起了那個重箱子。

q.en: Ben found a mysterious letter under his desk this morning.
q.zh: 班今天早上在書桌下發現了一封神祕的信。

q.en: The national museum in Taipei has many old paintings.
q.zh: 台北的國立博物館有許多古老的畫作。

q.en: Lisa folded her clothes neatly and put them in the drawer.
q.zh: 麗莎把衣服摺得整整齊齊，放進抽屜裡。

q.en: It is necessary to bring your student card to the exam.
q.zh: 考試時必須攜帶學生證。

q.en: Our neighbor often brings us fresh fruit from his garden.
q.zh: 我們的鄰居常把他花園裡的新鮮水果送給我們。

q.en: Kevin normally gets up at six and walks to school.
q.zh: 凱文通常六點起床，然後走路上學。

q.en: Amy borrowed a long novel from the school library yesterday.
q.zh: 艾美昨天從學校圖書館借了一本很長的小說。

q.en: Through careful observation, the students learned how plants grow.
q.zh: 透過仔細觀察，學生們了解了植物如何生長。

q.en: Kevin occasionally plays computer games after he finishes his homework.
q.zh: 凱文寫完功課後偶爾會玩電腦遊戲。

q.en: The cat behaved oddly and hid under the bed all day.
q.zh: 那隻貓行為很奇怪，一整天都躲在床底下。

q.en: Please check your answer sheet for any omission before handing it in.
q.zh: 交卷前請檢查答案卷有沒有遺漏。

q.en: Do you know how to operate this new copy machine?
q.zh: 你知道怎麼操作這台新的影印機嗎？

q.en: Many parents oppose the plan to start school earlier.
q.zh: 許多家長反對提早上課的計畫。

q.en: Her optimism helped the team stay calm during the hard game.
q.zh: 她的樂觀幫助球隊在艱難的比賽中保持冷靜。

q.en: Mr. Chen asked the students to answer the question orally.
q.zh: 陳老師要求學生口頭回答這個問題。

q.en: Amy joined an organization that helps stray dogs in her town.
q.zh: 艾美加入了一個幫助鎮上流浪狗的組織。

q.en: This old building was originally a school for girls.
q.zh: 這棟老建築原本是一所女子學校。

q.en: We had our English class outdoors because the weather was lovely.
q.zh: 因為天氣很好，我們在戶外上英文課。

q.en: Kevin enjoys outdoor activities such as hiking and cycling.
q.zh: 凱文喜歡爬山和騎車之類的戶外活動。

q.en: Lisa wrote her secret wish on the inner page of her notebook.
q.zh: 麗莎把她的秘密願望寫在筆記本的內頁上。

q.en: The owner of the bookstore gave Amy a small gift.
q.zh: 書店老闆送了艾美一份小禮物。

q.en: There is a beautiful painting of mountains in our classroom.
q.zh: 我們教室裡有一幅美麗的山景畫。

q.en: Kevin studied hard to pass the English exam last week.
q.zh: 凱文很用功讀書，為了通過上週的英文考試。

q.en: Lisa is passionate about painting and practices every weekend.
q.zh: 麗莎對繪畫充滿熱情，每個週末都練習。

q.en: Be patient with your little brother when he asks many questions.
q.zh: 弟弟問很多問題時，要對他有耐心。

q.en: Please walk on the pavement and watch out for passing bikes.
q.zh: 請走在人行道上，並注意經過的腳踏車。

q.en: The school band gave a wonderful performance at the festival.
q.zh: 學校樂隊在慶典上有精彩的表演。

q.en: Amy will perform a dance on the stage tomorrow evening.
q.zh: 艾美明天晚上要在舞台上表演一支舞。

q.en: Our school does not permit students to bring phones into the exam room.
q.zh: 我們學校不允許學生把手機帶進考場。

q.en: You must ask your teacher for permission before leaving the room.
q.zh: 離開教室之前，你必須先得到老師的許可。

q.en: Kevin gave a persuasive speech, and many classmates agreed with him.
q.zh: 凱文發表了一場很有說服力的演講，許多同學都同意他。

q.en: Amy joined the photography club to learn how to take better pictures.
q.zh: 艾美加入攝影社，想學習怎麼拍出更好的照片。

q.en: Ben is the pitcher of our school baseball team.
q.zh: 班是我們學校棒球隊的投手。

q.en: The pitiful puppy was shaking in the cold rain.
q.zh: 那隻可憐的小狗在冷雨中發抖。

q.en: Kids like to play in the park after school.
q.zh: 孩子們喜歡放學後在公園玩。

q.en: Lisa watched a film about polar bears in science class.
q.zh: 麗莎在自然課看了一部關於北極熊的影片。

q.en: Air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities.
q.zh: 空氣污染在許多大城市是個嚴重的問題。

q.en: The river near my house was once badly polluted by factories.
q.zh: 我家附近的河川曾經被工廠嚴重污染。

q.en: The postponement of the sports day made many students sad.
q.zh: 運動會延期讓許多學生很難過。

q.en: The poor man shared his bread with a hungry dog.
q.zh: 那個窮人把他的麵包分給一隻飢餓的狗。

q.en: Lisa needs more practice before the English speech contest next week.
q.zh: 麗莎在下週的英語演講比賽前需要多練習。

q.en: Amy is busy trying to prepare for the final exam.
q.zh: 艾美正忙著準備期末考。

q.en: Everyone in the class was present at the meeting this morning.
q.zh: 班上每個人今天早上都出席了會議。

q.en: Regular exercise is good for the prevention of many diseases.
q.zh: 規律運動有助於預防許多疾病。

q.en: Kevin had previously visited Japan, so he guided us around the city.
q.zh: 凱文之前去過日本，所以他帶我們逛遍那座城市。

q.en: It will probably rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
q.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

q.en: This factory can produce one thousand bikes every month.
q.zh: 這間工廠每個月可以生產一千輛腳踏車。

q.en: Our farm can produce enough vegetables for the whole village.
q.zh: 我們的農場可以生產足夠整個村子吃的蔬菜。

q.en: Kevin dreams of becoming a professional basketball player one day.
q.zh: 凱文夢想有一天成為職業籃球員。

q.en: Selling bubble tea is a profitable business near our school.
q.zh: 在我們學校附近賣珍珠奶茶是門賺錢的生意。

q.en: Lisa's father got a promotion at his company last month.
q.zh: 麗莎的爸爸上個月在公司獲得升遷。

q.en: Amy practices her English pronunciation by reading aloud every day.
q.zh: 艾美每天朗讀來練習她的英語發音。

q.en: Can you prove that your answer to this math problem is correct?
q.zh: 你能證明你這題數學的答案是對的嗎？

q.en: A helmet can protect your head when you ride a bike.
q.zh: 騎腳踏車時，安全帽可以保護你的頭。

q.en: This machine can purify the water in our school.
q.zh: 這台機器可以淨化我們學校的水。

q.en: Please put the speaker's exact words in quotation marks.
q.zh: 請把說話者的原話放在引號裡。

q.en: Ben ran fast and won the race at our sports day.
q.zh: 班跑得很快，在我們的運動會上贏得了賽跑。

q.en: What was your mother's reaction when she saw your test score?
q.zh: 你媽媽看到你的考試成績時有什麼反應？

q.en: How did the students react to the surprise party?
q.zh: 學生們對這場驚喜派對有什麼反應？

q.en: Kevin gave a good reason for being late to class.
q.zh: 凱文為他上課遲到提出了一個好理由。

q.en: Amy hopes to receive a postcard from her friend in Japan.
q.zh: 艾美希望能收到她日本朋友寄來的明信片。

q.en: Did you receive my message about tomorrow's school trip?
q.zh: 你有收到我關於明天校外教學的訊息嗎？

q.en: The student won recognition for her kindness at the school award ceremony.
q.zh: 那位學生在學校頒獎典禮上因她的善良而獲得肯定。

q.en: Lisa made a recording of her piano music for her grandmother.
q.zh: 麗莎為她奶奶錄了一段她彈的鋼琴曲。

q.en: Our classroom has a large rectangular table in the middle.
q.zh: 我們教室中間有一張大的長方形桌子。

q.en: The shop is offering a big price reduction this weekend.
q.zh: 這間店本週末有大幅度的降價。

q.en: Southern Taiwan is a warm region with lots of sunshine.
q.zh: 南台灣是個陽光充足的溫暖地區。

q.en: Listening to soft music is a relaxing way to end the day.
q.zh: 聽輕柔的音樂是結束一天的放鬆方式。

q.en: You can rely on Amy to finish the group report on time.
q.zh: 你可以放心讓艾美準時完成小組報告。

q.en: Kevin felt relieved after he handed in his final report.
q.zh: 凱文交出期末報告之後鬆了一口氣。

q.en: Ben is a reliable friend who always keeps his promises.
q.zh: 班是個可靠的朋友，總是信守承諾。

q.en: Please finish the remaining homework before you play games.
q.zh: 在你玩遊戲之前，請先寫完剩下的功課。

q.en: Mom put a small reminder on the fridge about my dentist visit.
q.zh: 媽媽在冰箱上貼了一張提醒我看牙醫的小便條。

q.en: We need a replacement for the broken light in the hallway.
q.zh: 我們需要一個替代品來換走廊上壞掉的燈。

q.en: Amy was chosen as the class representative for the school meeting.
q.zh: 艾美被選為班級代表去參加校務會議。

q.en: Kevin will represent our school in the speech contest next month.
q.zh: 凱文下個月將代表我們學校參加演講比賽。

q.en: Mr. Chen made a reservation at a small restaurant for dinner.
q.zh: 陳老師為晚餐在一間小餐廳訂了位。

q.en: The team put up strong resistance, but they still lost the game.
q.zh: 球隊展現了強力的抵抗，但還是輸掉了比賽。

q.en: Lisa is a resourceful student who always finds a way to solve problems.
q.zh: 麗莎是個足智多謀的學生，總能找到解決問題的方法。

q.en: Please respond to my email as soon as you can.
q.zh: 請你盡快回覆我的電子郵件。

q.en: Amy is responsible for watering the plants in our classroom.
q.zh: 艾美負責幫我們教室的植物澆水。

q.en: There is a speed restriction near the school gate.
q.zh: 學校大門附近有速限規定。

q.en: It is risky to ride a bike in heavy rain.
q.zh: 在大雨中騎腳踏車很危險。

q.en: The rotten apple smelled bad, so Amy threw it away.
q.zh: 那顆爛蘋果聞起來很臭，所以艾美把它丟掉了。

q.en: Put the fruit in the fridge, or it will rot quickly.
q.zh: 把水果放進冰箱，否則它很快就會腐爛。

q.en: It takes roughly twenty minutes to walk from my home to school.
q.zh: 從我家走路到學校大約要二十分鐘。

q.en: The road to the farm was rough, and our bus shook a lot.
q.zh: 通往農場的路很崎嶇，我們的公車搖晃得很厲害。

q.en: Ben's old bike is so rusty that it makes a loud noise.
q.zh: 班的舊腳踏車鏽得很嚴重，會發出很大的聲音。

q.en: Kevin was satisfied with his score on the English test.
q.zh: 凱文對他的英文考試成績感到滿意。

q.en: Amy tries to save a little money from her allowance every week.
q.zh: 艾美每週都試著從零用錢裡存一點錢。

q.en: It rained so hard that we could scarcely see the road.
q.zh: 雨下得太大，我們幾乎看不到路。

q.en: Don't scare the cat, or it will run away.
q.zh: 不要嚇貓，不然牠會跑掉。

q.en: Lisa won a scholarship because of her excellent grades.
q.zh: 麗莎因為成績優異而獲得了獎學金。

q.en: The scholar gave a talk about old Taiwan maps at our school.
q.zh: 那位學者在我們學校演講，主題是台灣的古地圖。

q.en: Amy likes science class because she can do experiments.
q.zh: 艾美喜歡自然課，因為可以做實驗。

q.en: The class did a scientific experiment about plants and sunlight.
q.zh: 全班做了一個關於植物與陽光的科學實驗。

q.en: The new lock makes our bike room feel much more secure.
q.zh: 新的鎖讓我們的腳踏車間感覺安全多了。

q.en: Ben sensibly saved part of his allowance for the school trip.
q.zh: 班明智地把一部分零用錢存起來準備校外教學。

q.en: Amy and her sister study in separate classrooms this year.
q.zh: 艾咪和她妹妹今年在不同的教室上課。

q.en: Lisa polished her shoes until they began to shine.
q.zh: 麗莎把鞋子擦到開始發亮。

q.en: Kevin's hair is quite short, so he does not need a haircut yet.
q.zh: 凱文的頭髮還很短，所以他還不需要剪頭髮。

q.en: Mr. Chen asked us to shorten our reports to two pages.
q.zh: 陳老師要求我們把報告縮短成兩頁。

q.en: Our English scores improved significantly after the summer course.
q.zh: 暑期課程之後，我們的英文成績顯著進步了。

q.en: Lisa's new scarf feels soft and silky against her neck.
q.zh: 麗莎的新圍巾貼在脖子上又軟又滑。

q.en: Amy and her mother have similar taste in music.
q.zh: 艾咪和她媽媽的音樂品味很相似。

q.en: Ben sincerely thanked his teacher for helping him prepare for the exam.
q.zh: 班誠心感謝老師幫助他準備考試。

q.en: Lisa enjoys skating at the park after school.
q.zh: 麗莎喜歡放學後去公園溜冰。

q.en: Amy's brother is a very experienced skier who loves snow.
q.zh: 艾咪的哥哥是個經驗豐富的滑雪者，非常喜歡雪。

q.en: The chef cut the vegetables skillfully in only a few minutes.
q.zh: 主廚只用了幾分鐘就熟練地把蔬菜切好。

q.en: Ben put some cream on his dry skin after the swimming class.
q.zh: 游泳課後，班在他乾燥的皮膚上擦了一些乳液。

q.en: It was so hot that Amy wore a sleeveless shirt to school.
q.zh: 天氣太熱了，艾咪穿了無袖上衣去學校。

q.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor after the rain.
q.zh: 下雨後要小心，不要在濕地板上滑倒。

q.en: The old man looked sorrowful after hearing the sad news.
q.zh: 老先生聽到那個壞消息後看起來很悲傷。

q.en: Please tell me specifically what happened to your bike yesterday.
q.zh: 請明確地告訴我你的腳踏車昨天發生了什麼事。

q.en: Kevin cannot eat spicy food because it hurts his stomach.
q.zh: 凱文不能吃辣，因為會讓他胃痛。

q.en: The little boy is spoiled because his grandparents give him everything.
q.zh: 那個小男孩被寵壞了，因為他的祖父母什麼都給他。

q.en: A good job gives Kevin's family a sense of stability.
q.zh: 一份好工作讓凱文一家人有安定感。

q.en: Thousands of animals died of starvation during the long winter.
q.zh: 漫長的冬天裡，成千上萬的動物死於飢餓。

q.en: Amy's grades have improved steadily since she joined the study group.
q.zh: 自從艾咪加入讀書會，她的成績穩定進步。

q.en: The police caught the thief near the night market yesterday.
q.zh: 警察昨天在夜市附近抓到了那個小偷。

q.en: Please stick this note on the classroom door before class.
q.zh: 上課前請把這張便條貼在教室門上。

q.en: A big storm kept us from going to the beach on Sunday.
q.zh: 一場大暴風雨讓我們星期天沒辦法去海邊。

q.en: The coach made a strategic change to help the team win.
q.zh: 教練做了一項策略性的調整，幫助球隊獲勝。

q.en: Lisa lifts weights every day to strengthen her arm muscles.
q.zh: 麗莎每天舉重來強化手臂肌肉。

q.en: Ben stubbornly refused to admit that he had made a mistake.
q.zh: 班固執地不肯承認自己犯了錯。

q.en: Amy made a substantial effort to finish the project on time.
q.zh: 艾咪下了很大的功夫，準時完成了專題。

q.en: Our math teacher is explaining addition and subtraction to first graders today.
q.zh: 我們的數學老師今天正在對一年級生解釋加法和減法。

q.en: Kevin's family lives in a quiet suburban area near the river.
q.zh: 凱文一家住在河邊安靜的郊區。

q.en: Kind words can ease the suffering of a sick friend.
q.zh: 親切的話語能減輕生病朋友的痛苦。

q.en: Lisa did not sleep sufficiently, so she felt tired in class.
q.zh: 麗莎睡眠不足，所以上課時覺得很累。

q.en: Please summarize the main idea of this story in two sentences.
q.zh: 請用兩句話概述這個故事的主旨。

q.en: Amy tried to summarize the whole chapter in one short paragraph.
q.zh: 艾咪試著用一小段話概述整個章節。

q.en: Kevin never shows any sense of superiority over his classmates.
q.zh: 凱文從不對同學表現出優越感。

q.en: Amy took photos of the beautiful surroundings during the hiking trip.
q.zh: 艾咪在健行途中拍了周遭美麗的環境。

q.en: Only a few plants can survive in such a dry desert.
q.zh: 在這麼乾燥的沙漠裡，只有少數植物能存活。

q.en: Mr. Chen felt suspicious when he saw a stranger near the classroom.
q.zh: 陳老師看到教室附近有陌生人時覺得很可疑。

q.en: The man standing outside the school looked suspicious to the guard.
q.zh: 站在學校外面的那個男人在警衛看來很可疑。

q.en: Ben's shirt was sweaty after he ran around the playground.
q.zh: 班繞著操場跑完後，襯衫都被汗濕了。

q.en: Kevin put ice on the swelling around his ankle after the game.
q.zh: 比賽後，凱文把冰塊敷在腳踝腫起來的地方。

q.en: The cat swiftly jumped onto the wall and disappeared.
q.zh: 那隻貓迅速跳上圍牆然後消失了。

q.en: Amy is a talented singer who often performs at school events.
q.zh: 艾咪是個很有天分的歌手，常在學校活動中表演。

q.en: Ben likes to talk with his friends during lunch break.
q.zh: 班喜歡在午休時間和朋友聊天。

q.en: This soup has a strange taste, so Lisa did not finish it.
q.zh: 這碗湯的味道很怪，所以麗莎沒有喝完。

q.en: Modern technology makes it easy for students to learn at home.
q.zh: 現代科技讓學生在家學習變得很容易。

q.en: Kevin called a technician to fix the broken projector.
q.zh: 凱文叫了技術人員來修理壞掉的投影機。

q.en: Lisa is a typical teenager who loves music and sports.
q.zh: 麗莎是個典型的青少年，熱愛音樂和運動。

q.en: The school gym is temporarily closed because of the heavy rain.
q.zh: 因為大雨，學校體育館暫時關閉。

q.en: Ben has a tendency to forget his umbrella on rainy days.
q.zh: 班下雨天有忘記帶傘的習慣。

q.en: Amy wanted to thank her teacher for all the help.
q.zh: 艾咪想感謝老師的所有幫助。

q.en: Kevin felt thirsty after playing basketball in the hot sun.
q.zh: 凱文在大太陽下打完籃球後覺得口渴。

q.en: Dark clouds threaten to ruin our picnic this afternoon.
q.zh: 烏雲可能會破壞我們今天下午的野餐。

q.en: Heavy rain is a serious threat to the farmers' vegetables.
q.zh: 大雨對農夫的蔬菜是很嚴重的威脅。

q.en: Amy held her little brother's hand tightly in the crowded market.
q.zh: 在擁擠的市場裡，艾咪緊緊握著弟弟的手。

q.en: These jeans are too tight, so Ben needs a bigger size.
q.zh: 這件牛仔褲太緊了，所以班需要大一點的尺寸。

q.en: Lisa joined a three-day tour of southern Taiwan with her class.
q.zh: 麗莎和班上同學參加了三天的南台灣之旅。

q.en: Kevin's uncle works in the tourism industry in Hualien.
q.zh: 凱文的叔叔在花蓮的觀光業工作。

q.en: Taiwan has a long history of trade with other countries.
q.zh: 台灣和其他國家有悠久的貿易歷史。

q.en: Public transportation in Taipei is cheap and convenient for students.
q.zh: 台北的大眾運輸對學生來說便宜又方便。

q.en: Ben likes to travel to different cities during summer vacation.
q.zh: 班喜歡在暑假到不同的城市旅行。

q.en: Amy bought a trendy backpack at the night market.
q.zh: 艾咪在夜市買了一個很流行的背包。

q.en: We watched a tribal dance at the festival in Hualien.
q.zh: 我們在花蓮的慶典上看了部落舞蹈。

q.en: The magician showed us an amazing trick at the school party.
q.zh: 魔術師在學校的派對上表演了一個神奇的把戲。

q.en: Please tell me the truth about what happened to the window.
q.zh: 關於窗戶發生了什麼事，請告訴我真相。

q.en: The whole class showed great unity on the day of the sports meet.
q.zh: 運動會那天，全班展現出極大的團結。

q.en: This café is uniquely decorated with old books and maps.
q.zh: 這間咖啡店用舊書和地圖做了獨特的裝飾。

q.en: The whole team worked in perfect unity during the final game.
q.zh: 決賽中，整支球隊團結一致地比賽。

q.en: Let's unite our efforts to make the school festival a success.
q.zh: 讓我們團結力量，讓校慶成功。

q.en: The hotel near the station still has a vacancy for tonight.
q.zh: 車站附近的旅館今晚還有空房。

q.en: The night market sells various kinds of snacks.
q.zh: 夜市賣各式各樣的小吃。

q.en: There is a wide variety of fruit at the market.
q.zh: 市場裡有各式各樣的水果。

q.en: There is little variation in the temperature in Kaohsiung in summer.
q.zh: 高雄夏天的氣溫變化很小。

q.en: Many tiny insects are invisible to the human eye.
q.zh: 許多微小的昆蟲肉眼看不見。

q.en: Amy has good visual memory, so she remembers faces easily.
q.zh: 艾咪的視覺記憶很好，所以很容易記住人臉。

q.en: Ben still remembers the school trip vividly after ten years.
q.zh: 十年後，班仍然清楚記得那次校外教學。

q.en: Our class will vote on the place for the trip.
q.zh: 我們班要投票決定旅遊的地點。

q.en: Lisa's grandmother greeted us warmly at the door.
q.zh: 麗莎的奶奶在門口熱情地招呼我們。

q.en: The sign gave a clear warning about the wet floor.
q.zh: 告示牌清楚地警告地板是濕的。

q.en: Kevin felt weak after having a fever for three days.
q.zh: 凱文發燒三天後覺得很虛弱。

q.en: Many people believe that health is more important than wealth.
q.zh: 許多人認為健康比財富更重要。

q.en: Amy was a flower girl at her cousin's wedding last month.
q.zh: 艾咪上個月在表姊的婚禮上擔任花童。

q.en: Ben has a piano lesson once a week.
q.zh: 班每星期上一次鋼琴課。

q.en: The river is wide, so we need a boat to cross it.
q.zh: 這條河很寬，所以我們需要搭船過去。

q.en: It is wise to review your notes before the exam.
q.zh: 考試前複習筆記是明智的。

q.en: Lisa threw the candy wrapper into the trash can.
q.zh: 麗莎把糖果包裝紙丟進垃圾桶。

q.en: Our school holds a sports meet once a year.
q.zh: 我們學校每年舉辦一次運動會。

q.en: The young boy waved goodbye to his grandparents at the station.
q.zh: 那個小男孩在車站向祖父母揮手道別。

q.en: Kevin found an abandoned kitten near the school gate.
q.zh: 凱文在校門口附近發現一隻被遺棄的小貓。

q.en: Ben is absolutely right about the answer to question five.
q.zh: 班對第五題答案的看法絕對正確。

q.en: Amy found the novel so absorbing that she forgot to eat.
q.zh: 艾咪覺得那本小說太引人入勝，連吃飯都忘了。

q.en: Kevin's cousin attends a famous music academy in Taipei.
q.zh: 凱文的表哥就讀台北一所有名的音樂學院。

q.en: Chewing gum in class is not acceptable at our school.
q.zh: 在我們學校，上課嚼口香糖是不被接受的。

q.en: The library is easily accessible by bus from our school.
q.zh: 從我們學校搭公車很容易到達圖書館。

q.en: Amy accidentally dropped her phone into the water.
q.zh: 艾咪不小心把手機掉進水裡。

q.en: Winning first prize was a great accomplishment for the team.
q.zh: 贏得第一名對這支隊伍來說是很大的成就。

q.en: Mom opened a bank account for Lisa last week.
q.zh: 媽媽上星期幫麗莎開了一個銀行帳戶。

q.en: The weather report was not accurate this morning.
q.zh: 今天早上的天氣預報不準確。

q.en: The student denied the accusation and asked for proof.
q.zh: 那位學生否認這項指控，並要求拿出證據。

q.en: Amy is not well acquainted with her new neighbors yet.
q.zh: 艾咪對新鄰居還不太熟。

q.en: The acquisition of a second language takes time and practice.
q.zh: 習得第二外語需要時間和練習。

q.en: Ben is adaptable, so he quickly made friends at the new school.
q.zh: 班適應力很強，所以很快就在新學校交到朋友。

q.en: Online games can be addictive if you play them too long.
q.zh: 線上遊戲玩太久可能會讓人上癮。

q.en: Lisa did not prepare adequately for the English test.
q.zh: 麗莎沒有為英文考試做好充分的準備。

q.en: The teacher made a small adjustment to the exam schedule.
q.zh: 老師對考試時間表做了一點小調整。

q.en: We all admire Mr. Chen for his patience with students.
q.zh: 我們都很欽佩陳老師對學生的耐心。

q.en: Kevin's courage to help others is truly admirable.
q.zh: 凱文幫助別人的勇氣真令人欽佩。

q.en: Ben had to admit that he forgot his homework.
q.zh: 班不得不承認他忘了帶作業。

q.en: The adoption of a stray dog made Amy's family very happy.
q.zh: 領養一隻流浪狗讓艾咪一家人非常開心。

q.en: The dog barked aggressively at everyone who walked past the gate.
q.zh: 那隻狗對每一個經過大門的人兇猛地吠叫。

q.en: Everyone reached an agreement about the date of the party.
q.zh: 大家對派對的日期達成了共識。

q.en: Our school does not allow students to bring snacks to class.
q.zh: 我們學校不允許學生帶零食到教室。

q.en: Amy and Ben alternate between washing dishes and sweeping the floor.
q.zh: 艾咪和班輪流洗碗和掃地。

q.en: The ambiguity of the question confused many students in the exam.
q.zh: 這道題目的模糊不清讓許多考生很困惑。

q.en: Lisa's ambition is to become a famous doctor one day.
q.zh: 麗莎的志向是有一天成為有名的醫生。

q.en: Kevin told an amusing story that made everyone laugh.
q.zh: 凱文講了一個有趣的故事，讓大家都笑了。

q.en: Mr. Chen taught us how to analyze a poem.
q.zh: 陳老師教我們如何分析一首詩。

q.en: Amy wrote a careful analysis of the results of the experiment.
q.zh: 艾咪對實驗結果寫了一份仔細的分析。

q.en: The loud noise from the street is really annoying.
q.zh: 街上的吵雜聲真的很惱人。

q.en: The school holds a sports day annually in November.
q.zh: 學校每年十一月舉辦運動會。

q.en: Ben felt anxious before his first speech in English class.
q.zh: 班在英文課第一次上台演講前覺得很焦慮。

q.en: Kevin went to apologize to his friend for being late.
q.zh: 凱文去向朋友為遲到道歉。

q.en: The bus was apparently late because of the heavy traffic.
q.zh: 公車顯然是因為交通堵塞才晚到。

q.en: Amy plans to apply for a scholarship next month.
q.zh: 艾咪打算下個月申請獎學金。

q.en: Only one applicant was chosen for the school radio team.
q.zh: 只有一位申請人被選進學校廣播社。

q.en: Mom made a dentist appointment for Ben on Friday afternoon.
q.zh: 媽媽幫班預約了星期五下午的牙醫門診。

q.en: We really appreciate your help with the school festival.
q.zh: 我們非常感謝你對校慶的幫忙。

q.en: Lisa dressed appropriately for the interview at the library.
q.zh: 麗莎為了圖書館的面試穿著得宜。

q.en: Our parents do not approve of staying out late.
q.zh: 我們的父母不贊成在外面待到很晚。

q.en: Kevin is a talented young artist who draws comics.
q.zh: 凱文是個有才華的年輕藝術家，會畫漫畫。

q.en: It is a shame that the concert was canceled.
q.zh: 音樂會被取消了，真是可惜。

q.en: The whole school gathers in the hall for the morning assembly.
q.zh: 全校師生在大廳集合參加朝會。

q.en: Please assemble in front of the library at eight o'clock.
q.zh: 請在八點整到圖書館前集合。

q.en: Our English teacher gave us a long assignment on Friday.
q.zh: 我們的英文老師星期五出了一份很長的作業。

q.en: Mr. Chen's assistant handed out the exam papers.
q.zh: 陳老師的助理把考卷發了下去。

q.en: Amy joined the school's art association last semester.
q.zh: 艾咪上學期加入了學校的美術社團。

q.en: Many people associate summer with the smell of watermelon.
q.zh: 許多人會把夏天和西瓜的味道聯想在一起。

q.en: I assure you that Kevin will return the book tomorrow.
q.zh: 我向你保證凱文明天會把書還你。

q.en: The coach's assurance made the team feel much calmer.
q.zh: 教練的保證讓球隊安心多了。

q.en: Ben dreams of becoming a famous athlete someday.
q.zh: 班夢想有一天成為有名的運動員。

q.en: Mr. Lin explained the atomic structure of water to our class.
q.zh: 林老師向全班解釋了水的原子結構。

q.en: Mr. Lin said that every atom has a tiny center.
q.zh: 林老師說每個原子都有一個很小的核心。

q.en: Please open the attachment in the email from your teacher.
q.zh: 請打開老師寄來的電子郵件裡的附件。

q.en: Colorful flowers attract many butterflies to the school garden.
q.zh: 色彩繽紛的花朵吸引許多蝴蝶來到校園花園。

q.en: The shop closed after the bankruptcy of its owner.
q.zh: 這家店在老闆破產後就關門了。

q.en: Ben had to beg his sister for her math notes.
q.zh: 班不得不求他姊姊把數學筆記借給他。

q.en: Please behave well when we visit the museum tomorrow.
q.zh: 明天我們參觀博物館時，請守規矩。

q.en: Lisa wants to become a biologist and study sea animals.
q.zh: 麗莎想成為生物學家，研究海洋動物。

q.en: Mom made a banana milkshake with the new blender.
q.zh: 媽媽用新的果汁機做了香蕉奶昔。

q.en: Nobody likes a boastful person who talks about himself all day.
q.zh: 沒有人喜歡整天談論自己的愛自誇的人。

q.en: The broken window in the classroom was fixed yesterday.
q.zh: 教室裡壞掉的窗戶昨天修好了。

q.en: Amy used a calculator to check her math answers.
q.zh: 艾咪用計算機檢查她的數學答案。

q.en: Kevin can calculate the total cost in his head.
q.zh: 凱文可以在腦子裡算出總費用。

q.en: Please carry these boxes to the classroom for me.
q.zh: 請幫我把這些箱子搬到教室。

q.en: Amy's family likes to celebrate the Moon Festival together.
q.zh: 艾咪一家人喜歡一起慶祝中秋節。

q.en: Our school baseball team became the city champion last year.
q.zh: 我們學校的棒球隊去年成為全市冠軍。

q.en: Lisa has a cheerful character, so everyone likes her.
q.zh: 麗莎個性開朗，所以大家都喜歡她。

q.en: Amy joined a charitable group that helps stray animals.
q.zh: 艾咪加入了一個幫助流浪動物的慈善團體。

q.en: Mr. Lin showed us a chemical experiment in the lab.
q.zh: 林老師在實驗室裡示範了一個化學實驗給我們看。

q.en: The students sat in a circle on the grass.
q.zh: 學生們圍成一圈坐在草地上。

q.en: Good blood circulation helps keep your body warm.
q.zh: 良好的血液循環能讓身體保持溫暖。

q.en: Fresh air can circulate through the room when the windows are open.
q.zh: 窗戶打開時，新鮮空氣可以在房間裡流通。

q.en: A civilized person waits in line and speaks politely.
q.zh: 有教養的人會排隊並禮貌地說話。

q.en: Amy spoke with great clarity during the English speech contest.
q.zh: 艾咪在英語演講比賽中講得非常清楚。

q.en: Please classify these library books by subject before you leave today.
q.zh: 離開前，請依主題把這些圖書館的書分類。

q.en: The classification of the library books took Lisa the whole afternoon.
q.zh: 整理那些書的分類花了麗莎一整個下午。

q.en: Tom's clumsiness made him drop the lunch tray again today.
q.zh: 湯姆的笨手笨腳害他今天又打翻了午餐餐盤。

q.en: Amy needs a special key to decode the message her friend sent.
q.zh: 艾咪需要一把特別的鑰匙來解讀朋友傳來的訊息。

q.en: Kevin likes to combine fruit and yogurt for breakfast.
q.zh: 凱文喜歡早餐把水果和優格混在一起吃。

q.en: Mr. Chen is a funny comedian who often makes our class laugh.
q.zh: 陳老師是個風趣的喜劇演員，常常逗得我們全班大笑。

q.en: The captain gave a clear command to the whole team.
q.zh: 隊長對全隊下了一道明確的指令。

q.en: The sports commentator talked very fast during the basketball game last night.
q.zh: 昨晚籃球比賽時，體育評論員說話速度非常快。

q.en: Our school is near a busy commercial area with many shops.
q.zh: 我們學校靠近一個有很多商店的熱鬧商業區。

q.en: Amy showed great commitment to the school baseball team this year.
q.zh: 艾咪今年對學校的棒球隊展現出極大的投入。

q.zh: 音樂很大聲時，很難和班溝通。

q.en: Lisa asked her brother to accompany her to the night market.
q.zh: 麗莎請她哥哥陪她去逛夜市。

q.en: Kevin will compete in the swimming contest next month.
q.zh: 凱文下個月要參加游泳比賽。

q.en: There is strong competition for first place in our class.
q.zh: 我們班上爭奪第一名的競爭很激烈。

q.en: Amy trained hard so that she could compete in the finals.
q.zh: 艾咪努力訓練，這樣她才能參加決賽。

q.zh: 這個紙牌遊戲的規則對我來說太複雜了。

q.en: Lisa's aunt is a composer who writes songs for movies.
q.zh: 麗莎的阿姨是為電影寫歌的作曲家。

q.en: Lisa tried to compose a short song for her mother's birthday.
q.zh: 麗莎試著為媽媽的生日寫一首短曲。

q.zh: 我們校歌的作曲者是王老師。

q.en: Kevin needs a lot of concentration to solve this math problem.
q.zh: 凱文需要非常專心才能解出這道數學題。

q.zh: 電視很吵的時候，艾咪很難專心寫作業。

q.en: Amy is concerned about the coming English exam.
q.zh: 艾咪很擔心即將到來的英文考試。

q.en: Mr. Chen will conduct a science experiment in class today.
q.zh: 陳老師今天會在課堂上進行一個科學實驗。

q.zh: 那個男孩向老師坦承了打破窗戶的事。

q.zh: 麗莎在英語演講比賽前覺得很有信心。

q.en: The long train schedule is confusing to many tourists.
q.zh: 這張很長的火車時刻表讓許多遊客感到困惑。

q.en: We gave Kevin our warm congratulations on winning the speech contest.
q.zh: 我們向凱文獻上熱烈的祝賀，恭喜他贏得演講比賽。

q.en: Ben was conscious of the people staring at him.
q.zh: 班意識到有人正盯著他看。

q.en: Amy missed the early bus and consequently arrived late for school.
q.zh: 艾咪錯過了早班公車，因此上學遲到了。

q.en: Staying up late every night can have a serious consequence.
q.zh: 每天熬夜可能會帶來嚴重的後果。

q.en: We should conserve water during the dry season.
q.zh: 我們在乾季應該節約用水。

q.en: Kevin is a consistent student who studies every day.
q.zh: 凱文是個很有恆心的學生，每天都讀書。

q.en: Amy has consistently ranked first in her class this year.
q.zh: 艾咪今年的成績一直都是班上第一名。

q.en: The constitution protects the basic rights of all people in Taiwan.
q.zh: 憲法保障台灣所有人民的基本權利。

q.en: Freedom of speech is a constitutional right in many countries.
q.zh: 言論自由在許多國家都是憲法賦予的權利。

q.en: The construction of the new library will finish next spring.
q.zh: 新圖書館的興建工程將在明年春天完工。

q.zh: 工人們將在河上建造一座橋。

q.zh: 麗莎和艾咪打算為自然課做一個房屋模型。

q.zh: 經過簡短的看診後，醫生換了班的藥。

q.zh: 如果你的咳嗽一直不停，應該去看醫生。

q.en: The consumption of sweet drinks has risen among students.
q.zh: 學生之間含糖飲料的消費量增加了。

q.zh: 這輛舊車長途旅行會耗掉很多油。

q.zh: 教室裡這個大箱子大約可以裝五十本書。

q.zh: 離開學校前，請檢查你書包裡的東西。

q.en: The old man looked contented as he drank tea by the window.
q.zh: 那位老先生坐在窗邊喝茶，看起來很滿足。

q.en: Every contestant had three minutes to sing on stage.
q.zh: 每位參賽者都有三分鐘可以在台上唱歌。

q.zh: 那個嬰兒整個漫長的夜晚都不停地哭。

q.zh: 台北連續下了三天的雨。

q.en: Amy made a great contribution to our class play.
q.zh: 艾咪對我們班的話劇貢獻很大。

q.zh: 大家都應該出點錢買班級禮物。

q.en: The new MRT line is very convenient for students.
q.zh: 新的捷運路線對學生來說非常方便。

q.zh: 在日本遇到老師時鞠躬是慣例。

q.en: The teachers will attend a science convention in Taichung next week.
q.zh: 老師們下週會去台中參加一場科學大會。

q.en: Amy had a long conversation with her grandmother last night.
q.zh: 艾咪昨晚和奶奶聊了很久。

q.en: Kevin gave a convincing reason for being late.
q.zh: 凱文為自己的遲到提出了一個有說服力的理由。

q.en: Our new classmate is friendly and very cooperative.
q.zh: 我們的新同學很友善，而且非常願意合作。

q.en: Students must cooperate to finish the group project.
q.zh: 學生們必須合作才能完成小組報告。

q.en: Thank you for your cooperation during the fire drill.
q.zh: 感謝大家在消防演習中的配合。

q.en: Amy keeps up her correspondence with a pen friend in Canada.
q.zh: 艾咪持續和一位加拿大的筆友通信。

q.zh: 艾咪要在全校面前演講，真的需要很大的勇氣。

q.en: The bus driver was always courteous to old passengers.
q.zh: 那位公車司機對年長的乘客總是很有禮貌。

q.en: It is cowardly to run away from your own mistakes.
q.zh: 逃避自己的錯誤是很懦弱的。

q.en: The old craftsman makes beautiful bamboo baskets in his small shop.
q.zh: 那位老工匠在他的小店裡做出漂亮的竹籃。

q.en: Kevin wants to create a new game for his little sister.
q.zh: 凱文想為他的妹妹設計一款新遊戲。

q.en: Lisa is a creative girl who makes funny cards.
q.zh: 麗莎是個很有創意的女孩，會做有趣的卡片。

q.en: Amy accepted her teacher's criticism with a smile.
q.zh: 艾咪面帶微笑地接受了老師的批評。

q.en: It is easy to criticize others but hard to help them.
q.zh: 批評別人很容易，但幫助他們很難。

q.en: The movie critic gave the new film four stars.
q.zh: 那位影評人給這部新電影四顆星。

q.en: Ben felt sad after hearing so much criticism from his classmates.
q.zh: 聽到同學那麼多的批評後，班覺得很難過。

q.en: It is cruel to leave a puppy alone in the rain.
q.zh: 把小狗獨自留在雨中是很殘忍的。

q.en: Ben likes to crunch on fresh apples after lunch.
q.zh: 班喜歡在午餐後嘎吱嘎吱地啃新鮮的蘋果。

q.en: The curious boy opened the box to see what was inside.
q.zh: 那個好奇的男孩打開盒子看裡面有什麼。

q.en: Amy has long curly hair just like her mother.
q.zh: 艾咪和她媽媽一樣有一頭長長的捲髮。

q.en: The curved road near our school is dangerous when it rains.
q.zh: 我們學校附近那條彎曲的路下雨時很危險。

q.en: The principal made a declaration about the new school rules.
q.zh: 校長宣布了新的校規。

q.en: Lisa and Amy will decorate the classroom for the school fair.
q.zh: 麗莎和艾咪要為園遊會布置教室。

q.en: Our best defender stopped the ball again in the final game.
q.zh: 我們最好的防守球員在決賽中又擋下了那顆球。

q.zh: 守門員在最後一分鐘拚命守住球門。

q.zh: 我們隊強大的防守讓我們贏得了籃球賽。

q.zh: 凱文在班上討論時試圖為自己的想法辯護。

q.zh: 艾咪下個月一定會參加校外教學。

q.zh: 臭豆腐是台灣夜市裡有名的美味小吃。

q.en: Lisa was delighted to get a letter from her cousin.
q.zh: 麗莎收到表姊的信覺得很高興。

q.en: The children shouted with delight when they saw the zoo.
q.zh: 孩子們看到動物園時高興地大叫。

q.zh: 林老師是個要求很高的老師，會出很多作業。

q.en: The cook gave a short demonstration of how to make dumplings.
q.zh: 廚師簡短地示範了如何包水餃。

q.en: Mr. Chen will demonstrate how to use the new machine.
q.zh: 陳老師會示範如何使用這台新機器。

q.en: Taipei is a densely populated city with many tall buildings.
q.zh: 台北是個人口稠密的城市，有許多高樓大廈。

q.en: The departure of the train was delayed by ten minutes.
q.zh: 火車的出發時間延誤了十分鐘。

q.zh: 火車將在九點整從台北車站出發。

q.en: Whether we go hiking will depend on the weather.
q.zh: 我們是否去健行要看天氣而定。

q.zh: 學校裡寒冷的雨天總是讓艾咪心情低落。

q.zh: 班拚命想在上課前找到他弄丟的手機。

q.zh: 強烈颱風一夜之間就能摧毀許多老房子。

q.en: This machine can detect small changes in the weather.
q.zh: 這台機器可以偵測到天氣的細微變化。

q.en: Kevin is determined to win the speech contest this year.
q.zh: 凱文下定決心今年要贏得演講比賽。

q.en: Lisa bought a small device that helps her wake up early.
q.zh: 麗莎買了一個幫助她早起的小裝置。

q.en: Amy is devoted to her little brother and always helps him.
q.zh: 艾咪很疼愛她的弟弟，總是幫他的忙。

q.zh: 這兩個包包之間有很大的差別。

q.zh: 晚餐後在公園裡散步對消化有益。

q.zh: 班寫下了電話號碼的最後一個數字。

q.zh: 艾咪是個勤奮的學生，每晚都讀書。

q.zh: 凱文每天放學後的下午都勤奮地練鋼琴。

q.zh: 這兩個國家上週舉行了一場外交會議。

q.en: The MRT station has special seats for disabled passengers.
q.zh: 捷運站有給身障乘客的專用座位。

q.en: Being tall is a great advantage in playing basketball.
q.zh: 身高高對打籃球是一大優勢。

q.en: Ben was disappointed when the picnic was canceled.
q.zh: 野餐被取消時，班覺得很失望。

q.en: The heavy rain had a disastrous effect on the farm.
q.zh: 大雨對農場造成了災難性的影響。

q.en: Lisa is a disciplined girl who gets up at six every day.
q.zh: 麗莎是個很自律的女孩，每天六點起床。

q.en: Amy felt discouraged after failing the math test twice.
q.zh: 艾咪數學考試連續兩次不及格後覺得很氣餒。

q.en: The smell from the old trash can was disgusting.
q.zh: 那個舊垃圾桶的味道令人作嘔。

q.en: The workers were shocked by the sudden dismissal of their manager.
q.zh: 工人們對經理被突然解僱感到震驚。

q.en: Lisa has a distinctive voice that everyone remembers.
q.zh: 麗莎有一個大家都記得的獨特嗓音。

q.en: There is a clear distinction between a rabbit and a hare.
q.zh: 兔子和野兔之間有明顯的區別。

q.en: Can you distinguish the twins when they wear the same clothes?
q.zh: 雙胞胎穿同樣的衣服時，你分得出來誰是誰嗎？

q.en: The distribution of free lunch boxes started at noon.
q.zh: 免費便當的發放從中午開始。

q.zh: 艾咪會把考卷發給每一位學生。

q.zh: 那則令人不安的消息讓艾咪整晚睡不著。

q.zh: 台灣以多樣的美食聞名。

q.zh: 我們學校有來自各種不同背景的學生。

q.en: Large companies dominate the market for cell phones.
q.zh: 大公司主宰了手機市場。

q.en: Rice is the dominant crop in southern Taiwan.
q.zh: 稻米是台灣南部最主要的農作物。

q.zh: 我們校外教學期間天氣糟透了。

q.en: Please clean the dust off the table before dinner.
q.zh: 晚餐前請把桌上的灰塵擦乾淨。

q.en: Amy listened earnestly to the teacher's advice about the exam.
q.zh: 艾咪認真聆聽老師對考試的建議。

q.zh: 觀光對這個小鎮的經濟很重要。

q.zh: 麗莎省吃儉用地花零用錢，每週還存一些。

q.zh: 那位經濟學家今早在廣播中談到物價上漲。

q.en: Rising prices are an economic problem for many families.
q.zh: 物價上漲對許多家庭來說是個經濟問題。

q.en: A small car is more economical than a big one.
q.zh: 小車比大車更省錢。

q.en: Kevin found an efficient way to memorize new words.
q.zh: 凱文找到一個有效率的方法來背新單字。

q.en: Amy bought an electronic dictionary for her English class.
q.zh: 艾咪為了英文課買了一本電子字典。

q.en: The dancer moved across the stage with great elegance.
q.zh: 那位舞者優雅地走過舞台。

q.en: The elimination of plastic bags in shops helps the environment.
q.zh: 商店不再提供塑膠袋對環境有幫助。

q.zh: 班忘記自己的座號時覺得很尷尬。

q.zh: 大使在我們學校發表了一場簡短的演說。

q.en: Please stay calm and use the stairs in an emergency.
q.zh: 遇到緊急狀況時，請保持冷靜並走樓梯。

q.en: Our teacher likes to emphasize the importance of reading every day.
q.zh: 我們老師喜歡強調每天閱讀的重要性。

q.zh: 跑者需要很強的耐力才能跑完馬拉松。

q.zh: 凱文對自己的考試成績感到非常高興。

q.en: The class play was so entertaining that everyone clapped.

q.en: Lisa is very enthusiastic about learning English with her friends.
q.zh: 麗莎對和朋友一起學英文非常有熱忱。

q.zh: 我們學校的所有學生都應該受到平等的對待。

q.en: Our new science lab is fully equipped with computers.
q.zh: 我們新的科學實驗室配備了齊全的電腦。

q.zh: 凱文的想法基本上和艾咪的想法一樣。

q.zh: 不要低估麗莎解難數學題的能力。
