q.en: Mr. Chen will evaluate each student's speech after class.
q.zh: 陳老師會在下課後評估每位學生的演講。

q.en: After many tries, Amy eventually learned to ride a bike.
q.zh: 試了很多次之後，艾咪終於學會騎腳踏車。

q.en: It was evident that Lisa had studied hard for the test.
q.zh: 很明顯麗莎為了這次考試很努力讀書。

q.en: The teacher asked Kevin for evidence to support his idea.
q.zh: 老師要凱文提出證據來支持他的想法。

q.en: Saying Kevin ate ten bowls of rice is an exaggeration.
q.zh: 說凱文吃了十碗飯是誇大其詞。

q.en: Amy has an exceptional talent for painting beautiful pictures of flowers.
q.zh: 艾咪在畫美麗的花卉圖畫上有卓越的天分。

q.en: Kevin felt exhausted after running the long race.
q.zh: 凱文跑完長跑比賽後覺得筋疲力盡。

q.en: Our class visited an art exhibition in Taipei last Friday.
q.zh: 我們班上週五去台北參觀了一場藝術展。

q.en: The expansion of the school playground took three months.
q.zh: 學校操場的擴建工程花了三個月。

q.en: The city plans to expand its MRT lines next year.
q.zh: 這座城市打算明年擴建捷運路線。

q.en: Our science teacher asked us to do an experiment today.
q.zh: 我們的自然老師今天要我們做一個實驗。

q.en: Can you explain how this machine works, Mr. Lin?
q.zh: 林老師，您可以解釋這台機器如何運作嗎？

q.en: The balloon will explode if you blow it up too much.
q.zh: 氣球吹得太大會爆掉。

q.en: The loud explosion of firecrackers scared the little dog.
q.zh: 鞭炮的巨響嚇到了那隻小狗。

q.en: Too much exposure to the sun can hurt your skin.
q.zh: 過度曝曬在太陽下會傷害皮膚。

q.en: Don't expose your new phone to the rain this afternoon.
q.zh: 今天下午別讓你的新手機淋到雨。

q.en: Amy asked for an extension on her science report.
q.zh: 艾咪要求延後交自然科報告。

q.en: Lisa did extensive reading before writing her report.
q.zh: 麗莎在寫報告前做了大量的閱讀。

q.en: Kevin has faith that he can pass the exam.
q.zh: 凱文相信自己可以通過考試。

q.en: This restaurant is famous for its beef noodles.
q.zh: 這家餐廳以牛肉麵聞名。

q.en: Amy likes to read fantasy stories before bed.
q.zh: 艾咪喜歡睡前讀奇幻故事。

q.en: The view from the top of the mountain is fantastic.
q.zh: 從山頂上看出去的景色棒極了。

q.en: Nobody knew the fate of the lost puppy.
q.zh: 沒有人知道那隻走失小狗的下場。

q.en: Can you do me a favor and carry these books?
q.zh: 你可以幫我個忙，幫我拿這些書嗎？

q.en: Farmers use fertilizer to help their crops grow.
q.zh: 農夫用肥料幫助農作物生長。

q.en: Lisa's favorite character is a fictional detective in a mystery book.
q.zh: 麗莎最喜歡的角色是一本推理小說中虛構的偵探。

q.en: The two teams played fiercely for the championship.
q.zh: 兩隊為了冠軍打得非常激烈。

q.en: Kevin's family can give him financial help for college.
q.zh: 凱文的家人可以在經濟上幫助他上大學。

q.en: Amy is saving money to become financially independent someday.
q.zh: 艾咪正在存錢，希望有一天能在經濟上獨立。

q.en: Ben knows that flattery will not help him pass the test.
q.zh: 班知道奉承對他通過考試沒有幫助。

q.en: Doing yoga twice a week helps Amy improve her flexibility.
q.zh: 每週做兩次瑜珈幫助艾咪提升柔軟度。

q.en: Lisa speaks English fluently after living abroad for a year.
q.zh: 麗莎在國外住了一年後，英語說得很流利。

q.en: Eating in the library is forbidden by the school rules.
q.zh: 依校規，在圖書館裡飲食是被禁止的。

q.en: Clouds form when warm air rises and cools down.
q.zh: 暖空氣上升冷卻時就會形成雲。

q.en: Ben missed the bus but fortunately his father drove him to school.
q.zh: 班錯過了公車，但幸好他爸爸開車載他去學校。

q.en: Mr. Lin wants to found a small reading club at school.
q.zh: 林老師想在學校創辦一個小型讀書會。

q.en: Amy is a frequent visitor to the school library.
q.zh: 艾咪是學校圖書館的常客。

q.en: It was a frosty morning, so Amy wore a thick coat.
q.zh: 那是個寒冷結霜的早晨，所以艾咪穿了厚外套。

q.en: Kevin felt frustrated when his computer stopped working.
q.zh: 凱文的電腦當機時，他覺得很挫折。

q.en: Waiting for a late bus in the rain is frustrating.
q.zh: 在雨中等誤點的公車真令人沮喪。

q.en: Helping others can be a very fulfilling job.
q.zh: 幫助別人可以是一份很有成就感的工作。

q.en: The main function of this button is to turn on the light.
q.zh: 這個按鈕的主要功能是開燈。

q.en: Amy and Ben think fundamentally differently about money.
q.zh: 艾咪和班對金錢的看法根本上就不同。

q.en: Kevin typed furiously to finish the report before midnight.
q.zh: 凱文拚命打字，想在午夜前完成報告。

q.en: We bought some new furniture for the living room.
q.zh: 我們為客廳買了一些新家具。

q.en: Brown eyes are a genetic trait that runs in Amy's family.
q.zh: 棕色眼睛是艾咪家族遺傳的特徵。

q.en: Solar panels on the school roof generate electricity from sunlight.
q.zh: 學校屋頂上的太陽能板利用陽光發電。

q.en: Mr. Wang is generous and often treats us to dinner.
q.zh: 王老師很慷慨，常常請我們吃晚餐。

q.en: Amy genuinely wants to help her classmates with their English homework.
q.zh: 艾咪真心想幫助同學寫英文作業。

q.en: Amy has a gift for music and plays the piano very well.
q.zh: 艾咪有音樂天分，鋼琴彈得非常好。

q.en: Plastic waste is a global problem that needs our help.
q.zh: 塑膠垃圾是需要我們出力的全球性問題。

q.en: The team returned home in glory after winning the cup.
q.zh: 球隊贏得獎盃後光榮地返鄉。

q.en: The young dancer's graceful movements impressed the whole audience at school.
q.zh: 那位年輕舞者優雅的動作讓全校觀眾都留下深刻印象。

q.en: The swan swam gracefully across the quiet lake.
q.zh: 天鵝優雅地游過寧靜的湖面。

q.en: Mr. Chen graciously invited all of us to his home for tea.
q.zh: 陳老師親切地邀請我們全部到他家喝茶。

q.en: Kevin will graduate from senior high school next June.
q.zh: 凱文明年六月就要高中畢業了。

q.en: There is a grammatical mistake in the first sentence.
q.zh: 第一個句子裡有一個文法錯誤。

q.en: Mr. Lin teaches us English grammar every Tuesday morning.
q.zh: 林老師每週二早上教我們英文文法。

q.en: The graphic design of this poster is very attractive.
q.zh: 這張海報的平面設計非常吸引人。

q.en: Amy wrote a card to show her gratitude to the teacher.
q.zh: 艾咪寫了一張卡片向老師表達感謝。

q.en: We are grateful to our teachers for their help.
q.zh: 我們很感謝老師們的幫助。

q.en: The apple fell to the ground because of gravity.
q.zh: 蘋果因為重力掉到地上。

q.en: Lisa washed the grease off the plate with hot water.
q.zh: 麗莎用熱水把盤子上的油洗掉。

q.en: Students greet their teachers every morning at the school gate.
q.zh: 學生每天早上在校門口向老師問好。

q.en: Kevin began to grieve when his old dog died.
q.zh: 凱文的老狗死掉時，他開始感到悲痛。

q.en: A guard stood at the gate of the museum all day.
q.zh: 一名警衛整天站在博物館的大門口。

q.en: Ben felt guilty about breaking his sister's cup.
q.zh: 班為打破妹妹的杯子感到內疚。

q.en: Lisa felt a deep sense of guilt after lying to her mother.
q.zh: 麗莎對媽媽說謊後，內心感到很深的愧疚。

q.en: Reading a few pages before bed is a good habit.
q.zh: 睡前讀幾頁書是個好習慣。

q.en: Amy gave her friend a handwritten card for her birthday.
q.zh: 艾咪送給朋友一張手寫的生日卡片。

q.en: Lisa's family has a harmonious relationship with their neighbors.
q.zh: 麗莎的家人和鄰居相處得很和諧。

q.en: The coach spoke harshly to the players after the loss.
q.zh: 輸球之後，教練嚴厲地對球員說話。

q.en: Don't make a hasty decision when you are angry.
q.zh: 生氣的時候不要倉促做決定。

q.en: Ben hastily packed his bag and ran to the bus stop.
q.zh: 班匆匆收好書包，跑向公車站。

q.en: I hate waking up early on cold Monday mornings.
q.zh: 我討厭在寒冷的星期一早上早起。

q.en: Amy did not hesitate to help the old man.
q.zh: 艾咪毫不猶豫地幫助那位老先生。

q.en: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the paper.
q.zh: 在紙的中間畫一條水平線。

q.en: The food at that new restaurant near school tasted horrible.
q.zh: 學校附近那家新餐廳的食物吃起來很糟。

q.en: Water is a basic need for all human beings.
q.zh: 水是所有人類的基本需求。

q.en: Taiwan is usually hot and humid in the summer months.
q.zh: 台灣夏季通常又熱又潮濕。

q.en: Please show your student card to prove your identity.
q.zh: 請出示學生證來證明你的身分。

q.en: Can you identify the bird in this picture, Lisa?
q.zh: 麗莎，你能認出這張照片裡的鳥嗎？

q.en: Please show your identification at the front desk.
q.zh: 請在櫃檯出示你的身分證件。

q.en: Don't ignore the teacher's warning about the test.
q.zh: 不要忽視老師對這次考試的提醒。

q.en: His ignorance of the rules caused a lot of trouble.
q.zh: 他對規則的無知造成了許多麻煩。

q.en: Each page of this book has a colorful illustration.
q.zh: 這本書的每一頁都有一幅彩色插圖。

q.en: Teachers often use pictures to illustrate difficult ideas.
q.zh: 老師常用圖片來說明困難的概念。

q.en: Can you imagine living without a phone for a week?
q.zh: 你能想像一個星期沒有手機的生活嗎？

q.en: Lisa has a rich imagination and writes wonderful stories.
q.zh: 麗莎想像力豐富，寫出很棒的故事。

q.en: This bag is just a cheap imitation of an expensive one.
q.zh: 這個包包只是昂貴包包的廉價仿冒品。

q.en: The little boy likes to imitate his father.
q.zh: 那個小男孩喜歡模仿他的爸爸。

q.en: Amy's uncle plans to immigrate to Canada next year.
q.zh: 艾咪的叔叔打算明年移民加拿大。

q.en: Amy's uncle is an immigrant who now lives in Canada.
q.zh: 艾咪的叔叔是個移民，現在住在加拿大。

q.en: Many families immigrate to Canada to find better jobs.
q.zh: 許多家庭移民到加拿大尋找更好的工作。

q.en: What is the implication of this sentence, Mr. Chen?
q.zh: 陳老師，這個句子的言外之意是什麼？

q.en: Mr. Chen was impressed by Amy's clear speech.
q.zh: 陳老師對艾咪清楚的演講印象深刻。

q.en: The tour price will include lunch and a free drink.
q.zh: 旅遊費用包含午餐和一杯免費飲料。

q.en: The mountain view was incredibly beautiful at sunrise.
q.zh: 日出時的山景美得令人難以置信。

q.en: Arrows on the wall indicate the way to the exit.
q.zh: 牆上的箭頭指示出口的方向。

q.en: Wash your hands so you won't infect your classmates.
q.zh: 把手洗乾淨，才不會傳染給同學。

q.en: Ben uses a pump to inflate his bike tires.
q.zh: 班用打氣筒給他的腳踏車輪胎打氣。

q.en: Good friends have a strong influence on your life.
q.zh: 好朋友對你的人生有很大的影響。

q.en: Please give me more information about the school trip.
q.zh: 請給我更多關於校外教學的資訊。

q.en: Amy was initially afraid of dogs but now loves them.
q.zh: 艾咪起初很怕狗，但現在很喜歡牠們。

q.en: Kevin missed the game because of a knee injury.
q.zh: 凱文因為膝蓋受傷而錯過了比賽。

q.en: The little girl gave an innocent smile to her teacher.
q.zh: 那個小女孩對老師露出了天真的微笑。

q.en: Please follow the steps carefully for the insertion of the memory card.
q.zh: 請仔細依照步驟插入記憶卡。

q.en: The teacher will inspect our desks before we leave school today.
q.zh: 老師在我們放學前會檢查我們的書桌。

q.en: Mr. Chen gave us an inspiring speech before the final exam.
q.zh: 陳老師在期末考前給了我們一場鼓舞人心的演講。

q.en: Her grandmother was the inspiration for Amy's first short story.
q.zh: 艾咪的奶奶是她第一篇短篇故事的靈感來源。

q.en: The workers finished the installation of the new air conditioners yesterday.
q.zh: 工人昨天完成了新冷氣機的安裝。

q.en: Kevin's instinctive reaction was to catch the falling cup.
q.zh: 凱文的本能反應就是去接住掉落的杯子。

q.en: Lisa followed the teacher's instruction and handed in her homework early.
q.zh: 麗莎遵照老師的指示，提早交了作業。

q.en: Mr. Lin will instruct us how to use the science equipment.
q.zh: 林老師會教我們如何使用科學實驗器材。

q.en: Calling someone stupid is an insulting thing to say in class.
q.zh: 在課堂上說別人笨是很侮辱人的話。

q.en: Dad decided to insure his new car against theft and accidents.
q.zh: 爸爸決定為他的新車投保防竊與意外險。

q.en: Reading many books can help improve a child's intellect.
q.zh: 多讀書可以幫助提升孩子的智力。

q.en: Amy is an intelligent girl who always gets top scores in math.
q.zh: 艾咪是個聰明的女孩，數學總是拿高分。

q.en: I had no intention of hurting your feelings, Ben.
q.zh: 班，我沒有要傷害你感情的意思。

q.en: The intensity of the sunlight made it hard to keep our eyes open.
q.zh: 陽光的強度讓我們很難睜開眼睛。

q.en: Kevin felt intense pain in his leg after the basketball game.
q.zh: 籃球賽後，凱文覺得腿部劇烈疼痛。

q.en: I did not intend to be rude when I laughed at Ben.
q.zh: 我笑班的時候並不是有意要無禮。

q.en: This interactive game helps young children learn English in a fun way.
q.zh: 這個互動式遊戲讓幼童以有趣的方式學英文。

q.en: Students interact with each other more when they work in small groups.
q.zh: 學生分小組作業時，彼此的互動會更多。

q.en: Loud noise from the street caused interference with our online class.
q.zh: 街上的吵雜聲干擾了我們的線上課程。

q.en: Lisa works as an interpreter at international business meetings in Taipei.
q.zh: 麗莎在台北的國際商務會議擔任口譯員。

q.en: Please do not interrupt others while they are speaking in class.
q.zh: 請不要在別人說話時打斷他們。

q.en: Lisa made an intuitive choice and picked the correct answer.
q.zh: 麗莎憑直覺做了選擇，結果選對了答案。

q.en: Too many tourists tend to invade the quiet old street on weekends.
q.zh: 週末總有太多遊客湧入這條安靜的老街。

q.en: My uncle is an inventor who makes tiny machines for fun.
q.zh: 我叔叔是個發明家，他以做小機器為樂。

q.en: Kevin's uncle is a smart investor who reads the news every morning.
q.zh: 凱文的叔叔是個精明的投資人，每天早上都看新聞。

q.en: The teacher will investigate who left the window open last night.
q.zh: 老師會調查昨晚是誰沒關窗戶。

q.en: Ben was deeply involved in the school's music club last year.
q.zh: 班去年深入參與學校的音樂社。

q.en: The small village is isolated, so it takes hours to reach by bus.
q.zh: 這個小村莊很偏僻，搭公車要花好幾個小時才到得了。

q.en: Amy felt isolated when she moved to a new school in the middle of term.
q.zh: 艾咪學期中轉到新學校時覺得很孤立。

q.en: Kevin felt jealous when his classmate won the first prize.
q.zh: 凱文看到同學得到第一名時覺得很嫉妒。

q.en: A laborer on the farm gets up before sunrise every day.
q.zh: 農場的工人每天日出前就起床。

q.en: Please enlarge the photo so everyone in the back row can see.
q.zh: 請把照片放大，讓後排每個人都看得到。

q.en: It is unlawful to park your scooter in front of the school gate.
q.zh: 把機車停在校門口是違法的。

q.en: Amy enjoys learning new words by playing games on her phone.
q.zh: 艾咪喜歡用手機玩遊戲來學新單字。

q.en: The lecturer explained the topic clearly, so everyone understood the lesson.
q.zh: 講師把主題解釋得很清楚，所以大家都懂這堂課。

q.en: Mr. Chen will lecture on healthy eating habits in the hall.
q.zh: 陳老師將在禮堂演講健康飲食習慣。

q.en: The legendary singer from my hometown still sings at the night market.
q.zh: 我家鄉那位傳奇歌手還在夜市唱歌。

q.en: Lisa likes to read novels in her leisure time on weekends.
q.zh: 麗莎週末的空閒時間喜歡看小說。

q.en: The teacher asked us to write a lengthy report about our trip.
q.zh: 老師要我們寫一份關於旅行的長篇報告。

q.en: Don't lie to your parents about where you went after school.
q.zh: 放學後去了哪裡，不要對父母說謊。

q.en: Ben borrowed three comic books from the school library yesterday.
q.zh: 班昨天從學校圖書館借了三本漫畫。

q.en: My aunt is a licensed driver who teaches new drivers.
q.zh: 我阿姨是有執照的駕駛，專門教新手開車。

q.en: The museum has a time limit of two hours for each group.
q.zh: 博物館對每一組有兩小時的時間限制。

q.en: Amy wants to study Chinese literature at a university in Taipei.
q.zh: 艾咪想在台北的大學念中國文學。

q.en: Lisa joined the literary club because she loves writing short stories.
q.zh: 麗莎加入文學社，因為她愛寫短篇故事。

q.en: Ben gave a logical answer to the difficult math question.
q.zh: 班對那道困難的數學題給了合乎邏輯的答案。

q.en: Mr. Chen asked us to explain our ideas with clear logic.
q.zh: 陳老師要我們用清楚的邏輯說明想法。

q.en: Kevin's shoes were too loose, so he tied them again.
q.zh: 凱文的鞋子太鬆了，所以他又綁了一次。

q.en: Our old dog showed great loyalty to the family for fifteen years.
q.zh: 我們的老狗十五年來對這個家展現了極大的忠誠。

q.en: Our old dog stayed loyal to the family for fifteen years.
q.zh: 我們的老狗十五年來一直對這個家忠心不二。

q.en: Amy hopes to enjoy a life of luxury after she grows up.
q.zh: 艾咪希望長大後能過奢華的生活。

q.en: The family stayed in a luxurious hotel near the beach for two nights.
q.zh: 這家人在海邊一間豪華的飯店住了兩晚。

q.en: The factory bought a new machine to make plastic bottles.
q.zh: 工廠買了一台新機器來製造塑膠瓶。

q.en: Kevin stuck a small magnet on the refrigerator door.
q.zh: 凱文把一個小磁鐵貼在冰箱門上。

q.en: The door is broken, so we have to open it manually.
q.zh: 門壞了，所以我們得用手動打開。

q.en: This company is a famous manufacturer of bicycles in central Taiwan.
q.zh: 這家公司是台灣中部有名的腳踏車製造商。

q.en: The company will manufacture ten thousand school bags this month.
q.zh: 這家公司這個月將製造一萬個書包。

q.en: Amy is very mature for her age and always helps others.
q.zh: 艾咪以她的年齡來說很成熟，總是幫助別人。

q.en: The nurse will measure your height and weight this afternoon.
q.zh: 護理師今天下午會量你的身高和體重。

q.en: Please check the measurement of the table before you buy a tablecloth.
q.zh: 買桌布之前請先確認桌子的尺寸。

q.en: The mechanical clock on the wall still works well.
q.zh: 牆上那座機械鐘還運作得很好。

q.en: Our neighbor is a mechanic who fixes motorcycles near the station.
q.zh: 我們的鄰居是技工，在車站附近修理機車。

q.en: Amy has a good memory for faces and names.
q.zh: 艾咪對人臉和名字的記憶力很好。

q.en: Ben still has a happy memory of that summer camp.
q.zh: 班對那次夏令營仍有快樂的回憶。

q.en: The trip to the zoo was a memorable day for the kids.
q.zh: 去動物園的那趟旅行對孩子們是難忘的一天。

q.en: The merciful teacher gave Ben another chance to hand in his work.
q.zh: 仁慈的老師再給了班一次交作業的機會。

q.en: It was merely a joke, so please don't be angry, Amy.
q.zh: 那只是個玩笑，所以艾咪請別生氣。

q.en: Kevin left a message on the board for his classmates.
q.zh: 凱文在布告欄上留了一則訊息給同學。

q.en: Lisa's room was a mess after the busy exam week.
q.zh: 忙碌的考試週過後，麗莎的房間亂成一團。

q.en: Mr. Chen mildly reminded us to keep the classroom clean.
q.zh: 陳老師溫和地提醒我們要保持教室整潔。

q.en: About a million people visit the night market every year.
q.zh: 每年大約有一百萬人造訪這個夜市。

q.en: The old mine near the village closed many years ago.
q.zh: 村子附近那座舊礦坑多年前就關閉了。

q.en: We should minimize the use of plastic bags at home.
q.zh: 我們在家應該盡量減少使用塑膠袋。

q.en: A new rule from the ministry will start next semester.
q.zh: 部會的新規定將從下學期開始實施。

q.en: The minister of education visited our school last Monday.
q.zh: 教育部長上週一來我們學校參訪。

q.en: The mischievous boy hid his sister's shoes under the sofa.
q.zh: 那個頑皮的男孩把妹妹的鞋子藏在沙發底下。

q.en: Many people lived in misery during the long cold winter.
q.zh: 在漫長的寒冬裡，許多人生活得十分悲慘。

q.en: Amy was sad because, unfortunately, she lost her new umbrella.
q.zh: 艾咪很難過，因為很不幸地她弄丟了新雨傘。

q.en: The title of the article was misleading, so many readers were confused.
q.zh: 那篇文章的標題有誤導性，所以許多讀者都被弄糊塗了。

q.en: It was just a misunderstanding, so Ben and Kevin soon became friends again.
q.zh: 那只是個誤會，所以班和凱文很快又成了朋友。

q.en: Kevin exercises moderately three times a week to stay healthy.
q.zh: 凱文每週適度運動三次來保持健康。

q.en: Lisa smiled modestly when everyone praised her singing.
q.zh: 大家稱讚麗莎的歌聲時，她謙虛地笑了笑。

q.en: Despite his success, Ben stays modest and kind to his classmates.
q.zh: 儘管很成功，班對同學依然謙虛又和善。

q.en: Amy is a motivated student who studies English every day.
q.zh: 艾咪是個很有學習動力的學生，每天都讀英文。

q.en: A kind teacher can motivate students to work harder.
q.zh: 親切的老師能激勵學生更用功。

q.en: We plan to climb the highest mountain in Taiwan this winter.
q.zh: 我們打算今年冬天去爬台灣最高的山。

q.en: Kevin's shoes were covered in mud after the hiking trip.
q.zh: 健行之後，凱文的鞋子沾滿了泥巴。

q.en: Lisa learned the multiplication table in elementary school.
q.zh: 麗莎在小學就學會了乘法表。

q.en: Nobody could solve the mystery of the missing school bag.
q.zh: 沒有人能解開書包失蹤之謎。

q.en: The national museum in Taipei is open every day except Monday.
q.zh: 台北的國立博物館除了週一以外每天開放。

q.en: I need more time to finish my science project.
q.zh: 我需要更多時間完成我的自然科專題。

q.en: The old garden looked neglected after nobody took care of it.
q.zh: 沒人照顧後，那座老花園看起來荒廢了。

q.en: The two teams held a negotiation about the time of the game.
q.zh: 兩隊就比賽時間進行了協商。

q.en: Lisa made a sensible plan to save money for the trip.
q.zh: 麗莎訂了一個明智的計畫來存旅行的錢。

q.en: A large number of students joined the singing contest.
q.zh: 大量的學生參加了歌唱比賽。

q.en: The nurse at our school checked my temperature quickly.
q.zh: 學校的護理師很快幫我量了體溫。

q.en: Good nutrition is important for growing teenagers like us.
q.zh: 良好的營養對像我們這樣成長中的青少年很重要。

q.en: Children should obey the rules at school and at home.
q.zh: 孩子在學校和家裡都應該遵守規矩。

q.en: Everyone must obey the traffic rules when riding a bike.
q.zh: 騎腳踏車時每個人都必須遵守交通規則。

q.en: Does anyone object to the plan for Friday's picnic?
q.zh: 有人反對星期五野餐的計畫嗎？

q.en: A judge should look at every case objectively.
q.zh: 法官應該客觀地看待每一個案件。

q.en: Amy will observe the stars through her new telescope tonight.
q.zh: 艾咪今晚要用新望遠鏡觀察星星。

q.en: My brother occasionally cooks dinner for the whole family.
q.zh: 我哥哥偶爾會為全家人煮晚餐。

q.en: These books occupy too much space on my small desk.
q.zh: 這些書占了我小書桌太多空間。

q.en: Lisa wants to choose an occupation that helps other people.
q.zh: 麗莎想選擇一個能幫助別人的職業。

q.en: Ben felt offended when his friend laughed at his haircut.
q.zh: 朋友嘲笑班的髮型時，他覺得被冒犯了。

q.en: Please avoid saying offensive things about other people's looks.
q.zh: 請避免說冒犯別人外表的話。

q.en: I'm sorry if my joke seemed to offend you, Amy.
q.zh: 艾咪，如果我的玩笑冒犯到你了，我很抱歉。

q.en: Many parents are opposed to the idea of longer school days.
q.zh: 許多家長反對延長每天上課時間的想法。

q.en: Music is an optional class, so you can choose art instead.
q.zh: 音樂是選修課，所以你可以改選美術。

q.en: Lisa volunteers at an orphanage every Sunday afternoon.
q.zh: 麗莎每個週日下午到孤兒院當志工。

q.en: It's cold outside, so wear a warm coat, Ben.
q.zh: 外面很冷，所以穿件暖和的外套吧，班。

q.en: The road was partially blocked by a fallen tree after the storm.
q.zh: 暴風雨後，道路被一棵倒下的樹部分擋住了。

q.en: Many students participate in the school sports day every year.
q.zh: 許多學生每年都參加學校運動會。

q.en: Kevin is my partner for the science project.
q.zh: 凱文是我自然科專題的夥伴。

q.en: A large percentage of our class likes watching baseball.
q.zh: 我們班有很大比例的人喜歡看棒球。

q.en: About eighty percent of the students walk to school.
q.zh: 大約百分之八十的學生走路上學。

q.en: Lisa played the piano perfectly at the school concert.
q.zh: 麗莎在學校音樂會上完美地彈奏了鋼琴。

q.en: The shop closed permanently last month after twenty years.
q.zh: 那家店營業二十年後，上個月永久歇業了。

q.en: Lisa tried to persuade her parents to let her join the camp.
q.zh: 麗莎試著說服父母讓她參加營隊。

q.en: Amy tried to persuade her brother to clean the kitchen with her.
q.zh: 艾咪試著說服弟弟跟她一起打掃廚房。

q.en: Ben is an optimistic boy who always sees the bright side.
q.zh: 班是個樂觀的男孩，總是看到事情光明的一面。

q.en: The young swimmer's progress was truly phenomenal this year.
q.zh: 這位年輕游泳選手今年的進步真的驚人。

q.en: Amy wants to take a class in philosophy at university.
q.zh: 艾咪想在大學修一堂哲學課。

q.en: Mr. Lin enjoys reading about philosophy in his free time.
q.zh: 林老師閒暇時喜歡讀哲學的書。

q.en: The philosopher asked us a question about the meaning of life.
q.zh: 那位哲學家問了我們一個關於人生意義的問題。

q.en: My uncle is a photographer who takes pictures of mountains.
q.zh: 我叔叔是攝影師，專門拍山的照片。

q.en: Kevin is physically strong because he plays basketball every day.
q.zh: 凱文每天打籃球，所以身體很強壯。

q.en: Lisa enjoys physics class because the experiments are fun.
q.zh: 麗莎喜歡物理課，因為實驗很有趣。

q.en: The physical education class starts at nine o'clock tomorrow.
q.zh: 體育課明天九點開始。

q.en: There is plenty of food at the school picnic, so eat more.
q.zh: 學校野餐有很多食物，所以多吃一點。

q.en: The label says this poison must be kept away from children.
q.zh: 標籤上寫著這種毒藥必須放在孩子拿不到的地方。

q.en: Kevin is popular at school because he is kind to everyone.
q.zh: 凱文在學校很受歡迎，因為他對每個人都很親切。

q.en: Amy drew a portrait of her grandmother for the art class.
q.zh: 艾咪為美術課畫了一幅她奶奶的肖像。

q.en: Her bike is her most valuable possession, so she locks it carefully.
q.zh: 腳踏車是她最珍貴的財產，所以她小心地上鎖。

q.en: Our family does not possess a car, so we take the bus.
q.zh: 我們家沒有車，所以搭公車。

q.en: Ben went to the post office to mail a letter.
q.zh: 班去郵局寄了一封信。

q.en: This game could potentially help students learn vocabulary faster.
q.zh: 這個遊戲有可能幫助學生更快學會單字。

q.en: The bus arrives at precisely eight o'clock every morning.
q.zh: 公車每天早上八點整準時到站。

q.en: The weather is unpredictable in spring, so bring an umbrella.
q.zh: 春天的天氣難以預料，所以要帶傘。

q.en: Can you predict who will win the basketball game, Ben?
q.zh: 班，你能預測誰會贏得籃球賽嗎？

q.en: Amy will present her science project to the whole class tomorrow.
q.zh: 艾咪明天要對全班報告她的自然科專題。

q.en: Many people work hard to preserve the old buildings in our town.
q.zh: 許多人努力保存我們鎮上的老建築。

q.en: The preservation of old trees is important to our city.
q.zh: 保存老樹對我們的城市很重要。

q.en: Wearing a helmet can prevent serious head injuries on a bike.
q.zh: 騎腳踏車戴安全帽可以預防嚴重的頭部受傷。

q.en: Ben must finish his homework prior to watching TV tonight.
q.zh: 班今晚看電視之前必須先寫完功課。

q.en: Please knock before you enter, because this is a private room.
q.zh: 請先敲門再進來，因為這是私人房間。

q.en: Amy feels privileged to learn from such a kind teacher.
q.zh: 艾咪覺得能向這麼親切的老師學習是一種榮幸。

q.en: We will proceed to the next page after everyone finishes.
q.zh: 大家完成後，我們就繼續進行下一頁。

q.en: Please follow the procedure listed on the wall to start the machine.
q.zh: 請依照牆上列出的程序啟動機器。

q.en: The factory will produce ten thousand toys this week.
q.zh: 工廠這週將生產一萬個玩具。

q.en: Kevin's father is a professor at a university in Hsinchu.
q.zh: 凱文的爸爸是新竹一所大學的教授。

q.en: Teaching is a respected profession in Taiwan and many students admire it.
q.zh: 教書在台灣是受人尊敬的職業，許多學生都很仰慕。

q.en: The small bookstore made a small profit last month.
q.zh: 那家小書店上個月賺了一點小利潤。

q.en: Please promise me that you will go to bed early tonight.
q.zh: 請答應我你今晚會早點睡。

q.en: The school will promote healthy eating with a poster contest.
q.zh: 學校將舉辦海報比賽來推廣健康飲食。

q.en: Please reply promptly so we can book the restaurant soon.
q.zh: 請盡快回覆，這樣我們才能很快訂餐廳。

q.en: Mr. Lin showed us how to pronounce this difficult word correctly.
q.zh: 林老師示範了如何正確唸這個困難的單字。

q.en: Kevin will propose a new idea for the class party.
q.zh: 凱文會為班上派對提出一個新點子。

q.en: Hard work and good service bring prosperity to a small business.
q.zh: 努力工作與良好服務能為小生意帶來興旺。

q.en: This prosperous town has many schools, parks, and night markets.
q.zh: 這個繁榮的小鎮有許多學校、公園和夜市。

q.en: We wish you a year of health, happiness, and prosperity.
q.zh: 祝你這一年健康、快樂又興盛。

q.en: Lisa wants to study psychology to understand how people think.
q.zh: 麗莎想學心理學來了解人如何思考。

q.en: Stress can cause psychological problems, so take a break.
q.zh: 壓力會造成心理問題，所以要休息一下。

q.en: The school invited a psychologist to talk about exam stress.
q.zh: 學校邀請了一位心理學家來談考試壓力。

q.en: The publisher will print ten thousand copies of the new novel.
q.zh: 出版社將印一萬本這本新小說。

q.en: This library is open to the public every day.
q.zh: 這間圖書館每天都對大眾開放。

q.en: The publication of her first book made Lisa very happy.
q.zh: 第一本書的出版讓麗莎非常開心。

q.en: Amy hopes to publish her short stories in a school magazine.
q.zh: 艾咪希望能在校刊上發表她的短篇故事。

q.en: Ben's pursuit of his dream made him study hard every night.
q.zh: 班為了追求夢想，每晚都很努力讀書。

q.en: Kevin decided to pursue a career in music after graduating.
q.zh: 凱文決定畢業後從事音樂工作。

q.en: Our teacher likes to quote famous sayings in class.
q.zh: 我們的老師喜歡在課堂上引用名言。

q.en: It was a rainy day, so we stayed in the classroom.
q.zh: 那天下雨，所以我們待在教室裡。

q.en: In reality, the test was much easier than we expected.
q.zh: 實際上，這次考試比我們預期的簡單多了。

q.en: Kevin will receive his school report next Friday.
q.zh: 凱文下週五會收到他的成績單。

q.en: Amy could not recognize her old friend after ten years.
q.zh: 過了十年，艾咪認不出她的老朋友。

q.en: Ben needs a few days to recover from his cold.
q.zh: 班需要幾天的時間來從感冒中恢復。

q.en: Our school has a program for recycling paper and plastic bottles.
q.zh: 我們學校有回收紙類和寶特瓶的計畫。

q.en: The store will reduce the price of school bags this weekend.
q.zh: 這家店這個週末會調降書包的價格。

q.en: Please use this book as a reference for your report.
q.zh: 請把這本書當作你報告的參考資料。

q.en: Please refer to page ten for the answer to question three.
q.zh: 第三題的答案請參考第十頁。

q.en: Take a moment to look at your reflection in the mirror.
q.zh: 花點時間看看鏡中的自己吧。

q.en: The lake can reflect the mountains like a giant mirror.
q.zh: 湖面能像一面大鏡子般倒映出群山。

q.en: Kevin decided to refuse the extra dessert because he was full.
q.zh: 凱文因為吃飽了，決定拒絕多的點心。

q.en: Many students regard English as a very useful skill.
q.zh: 許多學生認為英文是很有用的技能。

q.en: Please complete your registration at the front desk before the class.
q.zh: 上課前請在櫃檯完成你的報到手續。

q.en: You can register for the summer camp on the school website.
q.zh: 你可以在學校網站上報名暑期營隊。

q.en: The school regulation says that students must wear name tags.
q.zh: 學校規定學生必須配戴名牌。

q.en: A thermostat can regulate the temperature of the whole classroom.
q.zh: 恆溫器可以調節整間教室的溫度。

q.en: Lisa felt sad when the club chose to reject her idea.
q.zh: 社團決定否決她的點子時，麗莎覺得很難過。

q.en: After the exam, Ben took a relaxing bath at home.
q.zh: 考完試後，班在家泡了個放鬆的澡。

q.en: Your answer is irrelevant to the question the teacher asked.
q.zh: 你的答案和老師問的問題無關。

q.en: Amy felt relieved after she handed in her final report.
q.zh: 艾咪交出期末報告後覺得鬆了一口氣。

q.en: Ben reluctantly agreed to join the cleaning team after lunch.
q.zh: 班不情願地同意午餐後加入打掃小組。

q.en: Lisa made remarkable progress in English this semester.
q.zh: 麗莎這學期的英文有顯著的進步。

q.en: Ben made an interesting remark about the movie.
q.zh: 班對那部電影發表了一個有趣的評論。

q.en: Solar power is a renewable energy source that will never run out.
q.zh: 太陽能是永不枯竭的再生能源。

q.en: Please repeat the question, because I could not hear you.
q.zh: 請重複一次問題，因為我沒聽到。

q.en: Kevin will represent our class in the speech contest.
q.zh: 凱文會代表我們班參加演講比賽。

q.en: Amy wants to become a researcher who studies sea animals.
q.zh: 艾咪想成為研究海洋動物的研究員。

q.en: Lisa did some research on healthy food for her project.
q.zh: 麗莎為了她的專題做了一些關於健康食物的研究。

q.en: There is a strong resemblance between Ben and his father.
q.zh: 班和他爸爸長得非常像。

q.en: Dad will reserve a table at the restaurant for Saturday night.
q.zh: 爸爸會預訂餐廳週六晚上的一張桌子。

q.en: The coach handed in his resignation after the team lost.
q.zh: 球隊輸球後，教練遞出了辭呈。

q.en: Mr. Wang decided to resign from his job at the factory.
q.zh: 王先生決定辭去工廠的工作。

q.en: It is hard to resist a cup of cold bubble tea in summer.
q.zh: 夏天很難抗拒一杯冰涼的珍珠奶茶。

q.en: Kevin was determined to resolve the problem before the next class.
q.zh: 凱文決心在下一堂課前解決這個問題。

q.en: Lisa's resolution this year is to read one book every week.
q.zh: 麗莎今年的決心是每週讀一本書。

q.en: Students should show respect to their teachers and elders.
q.zh: 學生應該對老師和長輩表示尊敬。

q.en: Ben always speaks to his grandparents with great respect.
q.zh: 班總是很恭敬地和祖父母說話。

q.en: The restoration of the old temple took almost three years.
q.zh: 那座老廟的修復工程花了將近三年。

q.en: The school will restrict phone use during class time.
q.zh: 學校會限制上課時間使用手機。

q.en: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
q.zh: 我退休的爺爺每天早上都在公園散步。

q.en: Please finish the revision of your essay before Friday.
q.zh: 請在週五前完成你作文的修改。

q.en: Amy will revise her speech again tonight to make it shorter.
q.zh: 艾咪今晚會再修改她的演講稿讓它變短。

q.en: The invention of the smartphone was a revolutionary step in communication.
q.zh: 智慧型手機的發明是通訊上革命性的一步。

q.en: The printing press led to a revolution in how people shared ideas.
q.zh: 印刷術讓人們分享想法的方式出現了革命。

q.en: Teaching young children is a rewarding job for many people.
q.zh: 教導幼童對許多人來說是一份有收穫的工作。

q.en: We walked around the ruined castle on our school trip.
q.zh: 我們在校外教學時繞著那座殘破的城堡走了一圈。

q.en: The old bike was covered in rust, so Dad threw it away.
q.zh: 那輛舊腳踏車滿是鏽，所以爸爸把它丟了。

q.en: Ben was satisfied with his score on the English test.
q.zh: 班對自己的英文考試成績很滿意。

q.en: Fresh water is scarce in some parts of the world.
q.zh: 世界上有些地方的淡水很稀少。

q.en: We enjoyed a scenic train ride along the east coast.

q.en: Kevin worked hard to master the piano before the school concert.
q.zh: 凱文在校內音樂會前努力精通鋼琴。

q.en: Mom is cooking dinner; meanwhile, I am setting the table.
q.zh: 媽媽在煮晚餐，同時我在擺餐具。

q.en: Ben's uncle is a mechanic who fixes cars at a small shop.
q.zh: 班的叔叔是機械技師，在一間小店修車。

q.en: Amy took some medicine for her cold and went to bed early.
q.zh: 艾咪吃了一些感冒藥就早早上床睡覺。

q.en: Many birds migrate to warmer places in the winter.
q.zh: 許多鳥類在冬天會遷徙到比較溫暖的地方。

q.en: Lisa needs a minimum of sixty points to pass the quiz.
q.zh: 麗莎至少需要六十分才能通過這次小考。

q.en: A minimum of ten students is needed to start the club.
q.zh: 要成立這個社團至少需要十名學生。

q.en: Our class has a mission to clean up the park this weekend.
q.zh: 我們班這個週末有個任務，要去清理公園。

q.en: Kevin was hurt by the mockery of his classmates.
q.zh: 凱文被同學的嘲笑傷到了。

q.en: Mr. Chen made a small modification to the test schedule.
q.zh: 陳老師對考試時間表做了一點小修改。

q.en: Ben learned an important moral lesson from the old story.
q.zh: 班從那個老故事裡學到了重要的道德教訓。

q.en: Good teachers know how to motivate their students to learn.
q.zh: 好老師知道如何激勵學生學習。

q.en: Swimming is a great way to exercise every muscle in your body.
q.zh: 游泳是鍛鍊全身每一塊肌肉的好方法。

q.en: Lisa loves reading Greek mythology in her free time.
q.zh: 麗莎空閒時喜歡讀希臘神話。

q.en: Amy naively believed that the test would be easy.
q.zh: 艾咪天真地以為這次考試會很簡單。

q.en: The narrator of the story is a ten-year-old boy.
q.zh: 這個故事的敘述者是一個十歲的男孩。

q.en: The two sides will negotiate the price this afternoon.
q.zh: 雙方將在今天下午協商價格。

q.en: Amy was happy to receive a nomination for class leader.
q.zh: 艾咪很高興獲得班長的提名。

q.en: We will nominate Kevin as the leader of our science club.
q.zh: 我們會提名凱文擔任我們科學社的社長。

q.en: Our class will nominate Lisa as the best reader this year.
q.zh: 我們班會提名麗莎為今年的閱讀之星。

q.en: The little bookstore made a small profit last month.
q.zh: 那家小書店上個月賺了一點利潤。

q.en: Ben's temperature was normal, so he went to school as usual.
q.zh: 班的體溫正常，所以他照常去上學。

q.en: Amy has improved noticeably in math since she joined the study group.
q.zh: 艾咪加入讀書小組後，數學明顯進步了。

q.en: The school sent a notification to all parents about the field trip.
q.zh: 學校發了一則關於校外教學的通知給所有家長。

q.en: Fresh vegetables are nutritious and good for growing teenagers.
q.zh: 新鮮蔬菜營養豐富，對成長中的青少年很好。

q.en: Milk is a nutritious drink that many students have at breakfast.
q.zh: 牛奶是許多學生早餐會喝的營養飲品。

q.en: Wearing a school uniform is obligatory on Mondays at our school.
q.zh: 在我們學校，星期一一定要穿制服。

q.en: Amy likes to observe birds in the park every Sunday morning.
q.zh: 艾咪喜歡每個星期天早上在公園觀察鳥類。

q.en: The shop will offer a discount to students this weekend.
q.zh: 這家店這個週末會提供學生折扣。

q.en: The new library will operate from eight to six every day.
q.zh: 新圖書館每天從八點開到六點。

q.en: Many parents oppose the plan to start school earlier.
q.zh: 許多家長反對提早上課的計畫。

q.zh: 麗莎坐在桌子對面，正對著艾咪。

q.en: Taking the bus is another option if it rains tomorrow.
q.zh: 如果明天下雨，搭公車是另一個選擇。

q.en: Amy is optimistic about the result because she studied hard.
q.zh: 艾咪對結果很樂觀，因為她很用功。

q.en: Joining the school trip is an option, not a rule.
q.zh: 參加校外教學是一種選擇，不是規定。

q.en: Ben only buys organic vegetables from the farmers' market.
q.zh: 班只在農夫市集買有機蔬菜。

q.en: Lisa's original idea won first prize in the school contest.
q.zh: 麗莎的原創點子在校內比賽中得到第一名。

q.en: The kids played outside until it got dark, so Mom called them in.
q.zh: 孩子們在外面玩到天黑，所以媽媽叫他們進來。

q.en: Kevin felt overwhelmed by all the homework due this week.
q.zh: 凱文對這週要交的所有功課感到不知所措。

q.en: Everyone is welcome to participate in the school sports day.
q.zh: 歡迎每個人都來參加學校運動會。

q.en: Amy only had partial answers to the last three questions.
q.zh: 艾咪對最後三題只答得出一部分。

q.en: Kevin has a deep passion for playing the guitar.
q.zh: 凱文對彈吉他有很深的熱情。

q.en: Ben's perception of the test changed after he studied with Amy.
q.zh: 班和艾咪一起讀書後，他對這次考試的看法改變了。

q.en: Many students perceive the final exam as a big challenge.
q.zh: 許多學生把期末考視為一大挑戰。

q.en: Lisa will perform a violin solo at the school festival.
q.zh: 麗莎將在校慶上表演小提琴獨奏。

q.en: Success often comes from persistence and hard work.
q.zh: 成功往往來自毅力和努力。

q.en: Please keep your personal items in the locker during class.
q.zh: 上課時請把個人物品放在置物櫃裡。

q.en: Ben felt pessimistic about the game after losing the first set.
q.zh: 班輸了第一局之後，對這場比賽感到悲觀。

q.en: Amy took a beautiful photograph of the sunset from the school roof.
q.zh: 艾咪從學校屋頂拍了一張美麗的夕陽照片。

q.en: Kevin can pitch the ball very fast in baseball practice.
q.zh: 凱文在棒球練習時可以投出很快的球。

q.en: Don't plead with me; I already said the answer is no.
q.zh: 不要再求我了，我已經說過答案是不行。

q.en: Amy listened to her brother's plea for more game time.
q.zh: 艾咪聽了弟弟想多玩一點遊戲的請求。

q.en: Lisa wrote a short poem for her mother on Mother's Day.
q.zh: 麗莎在母親節為媽媽寫了一首短詩。

q.en: Ben needs more practice before the English speech contest.
q.zh: 班在英語演講比賽前需要多練習。

q.en: Amy would prefer to stay home and read on rainy days.
q.zh: 下雨天艾咪比較想待在家裡看書。

q.en: Kevin is never prejudiced against people from other countries.
q.zh: 凱文從不對來自其他國家的人抱有偏見。

q.en: The doctor gave Amy a prescription for her bad cough.
q.zh: 醫生為艾咪的嚴重咳嗽開了處方。

q.en: The doctor will prescribe some medicine for your sore throat.
q.zh: 醫生會為你的喉嚨痛開一些藥。

q.en: Ben was elected president of the school student council last year.
q.zh: 班去年被選為學校學生會的會長。

q.en: Lisa hopes to become class president next semester.
q.zh: 麗莎希望下學期能當選班長。

q.en: I presume Kevin is late because of the heavy traffic.
q.zh: 我猜凱文是因為塞車才遲到的。

q.en: Amy is presumably still at school, because her bag is here.
q.zh: 艾咪大概還在學校，因為她的書包在這裡。

q.en: Finishing homework should be your first priority every night.
q.zh: 每天晚上完成功課應該是你的第一要務。

q.en: Taking short breaks can make you more productive when studying.
q.zh: 念書時適度休息可以讓你更有效率。

q.en: The story profoundly changed the way Amy thinks about friends.
q.zh: 那個故事深深改變了艾咪看待朋友的方式。

q.en: Ben has made great progress in English this semester.
q.zh: 班這學期的英文進步很多。

q.en: The prohibition of phones in class helps students focus.
q.zh: 上課禁用手機有助於學生專心。

q.en: Mr. Chen turned on the projector to start the lesson.
q.zh: 陳老師打開投影機開始上課。

q.en: The school will provide free lunch for students in need.
q.zh: 學校會為有需要的學生提供免費午餐。

q.en: Amy has the right qualification to join the national swim team.
q.zh: 艾咪具備加入國家游泳隊的資格。

q.en: The teacher said that racist jokes are never acceptable in our class.
q.zh: 老師說種族歧視的玩笑在我們班上絕對不被允許。

q.en: A small heater can radiate enough warmth to heat the whole room.
q.zh: 一台小暖爐就能散發足夠的熱度讓整間房間暖和起來。

q.en: The new principal radically changed how our school handles homework.
q.zh: 新校長徹底改變了我們學校處理作業的方式。

q.en: The rancher rises early every day to feed his cattle.
q.zh: 那位牧場主人每天一早起床餵他的牛。

q.en: The teacher randomly picked Amy to answer the first question.
q.zh: 老師隨機點了艾咪來回答第一題。

q.en: Try to think rationally before you make such an important decision.
q.zh: 在做這麼重要的決定之前，請試著理性思考。

q.en: Lisa's plan is realistic because it fits her budget and schedule.
q.zh: 莉莎的計畫很實際，因為符合她的預算和時間表。

q.en: Mr. Chen's reassuring smile made the nervous students feel calm.
q.zh: 陳老師令人安心的微笑讓緊張的學生們平靜下來。

q.en: Many teenagers become rebellious when parents control every part of their lives.
q.zh: 當父母掌控生活的每個層面時，許多青少年會變得叛逆。

q.en: Ben asked the librarian for a recommendation about science fiction novels.
q.zh: 班向圖書館員詢問有哪些科幻小說值得推薦。

q.en: Kevin's teacher will recommend him for the summer science camp.
q.zh: 凱文的老師會推薦他參加暑期科學營。

q.en: The company's recruitment of new workers begins next month.
q.zh: 這間公司下個月開始招募新員工。

q.en: A refugee from the flooded village stayed at our school gym.
q.zh: 一位來自被淹沒村莊的難民暫住在我們學校的體育館。

q.en: The band will rehearse every day after school before the concert.
q.zh: 樂團在演唱會前每天放學後都會排練。

q.en: Workers added steel bars as reinforcement for the old bridge.
q.zh: 工人為這座舊橋加了鋼筋作為補強。

q.en: Please remind me to bring my umbrella tomorrow morning.
q.zh: 請提醒我明天早上帶雨傘。

q.en: Lisa tried to remove the stain from her white shirt.
q.zh: 莉莎試著去除她白襯衫上的污漬。

q.en: My cousin plans to rent a small apartment near his school.
q.zh: 我表哥打算在學校附近租一間小公寓。

q.en: The repayment of the loan will take about three years.
q.zh: 這筆貸款的償還大約需要三年。

q.en: France is a republic with a president elected by the people.
q.zh: 法國是一個由人民選出總統的共和國。

q.en: Ben and his father resemble each other in many ways.
q.zh: 班和他爸爸在很多方面都很像。

q.en: Mr. Wang has been a resident of this quiet town for decades.
q.zh: 王先生已經在這個安靜的小鎮住了幾十年。

q.en: The old man's residence is only five minutes from our school.
q.zh: 那位老先生的住處離我們學校只有五分鐘。

q.en: Many students reside in the dormitory during the school week.
q.zh: 許多學生在上課週期間住在宿舍。

q.en: Please respond to the email before five o'clock today.
q.zh: 請在今天五點前回覆這封電子郵件。

q.en: The retailer sells school bags at very low prices.
q.zh: 這家零售商以很低的價格販售書包。

q.en: Ms. Lin asked a rhetorical question to make us think.
q.zh: 林老師問了一個反問句來讓我們思考。

q.en: Nobody should ridicule others for their appearance or accent.
q.zh: 沒有人應該因為別人的外表或口音而嘲笑他們。

q.en: Skipping breakfast every day is a risk to your health.
q.zh: 每天不吃早餐對你的健康是一種風險。

q.en: There is a friendly rivalry between our two basketball teams.
q.zh: 我們兩支籃球隊之間有著友善的競爭關係。

q.en: Lisa used the scanner in the library to copy her notes.
q.zh: 莉莎用圖書館的掃描機影印她的筆記。

q.en: The singer's sensational performance surprised everyone in the audience.
q.zh: 那位歌手轟動的表演讓全場觀眾都驚喜不已。

q.en: Amy is sensitive to cold weather, so she wears a scarf.
q.zh: 艾咪對寒冷的天氣很敏感，所以她會圍圍巾。

q.en: Grandma keeps the old doll for sentimental reasons.
q.zh: 奶奶出於懷舊的原因保留著那個舊娃娃。

q.en: There is strong public sentiment against building a factory near the river.
q.zh: 大眾強烈反對在河邊蓋工廠。

q.en: Amy works part-time to serve customers at a small noodle shop.
q.zh: 艾咪打工在一家小麵店服務客人。

q.en: Kevin likes to share his lunch with his classmates.
q.zh: 凱文喜歡和同學分享他的午餐。

q.en: The sneaky cat stole a piece of fish from the table.
q.zh: 那隻鬼鬼祟祟的貓從桌上偷了一塊魚。

q.en: The baby's blanket is so soft that she falls asleep quickly.
q.zh: 寶寶的毯子好柔軟，讓她很快就睡著了。

q.zh: 凱文這週單獨負責打掃教室。

q.zh: 新教室有足夠的空間放四十張桌子。

q.zh: 艾咪戴著一條閃閃發亮的項鍊去參加學校舞會。

q.zh: 今天是特別的日子，因為是艾咪的生日。

q.zh: 林醫師是市立醫院的心臟科專家。

q.en: This small restaurant will specialize in beef noodles and nothing else.
q.zh: 這間小餐廳將專攻牛肉麵，其他都不賣。

q.zh: 請舉一個具體的例子來支持你的意見。

q.en: There is a lot of speculation about who will win.
q.zh: 外界對於誰會獲勝有很多揣測。

q.zh: 肉桂是一種人們常用在甜點裡的香料。

q.en: The bank offered sponsorship for our school's science fair.
q.zh: 那家銀行為我們學校的科學展提供贊助。

q.en: A local bank agreed to sponsor our school's science fair.
q.zh: 一家當地銀行同意贊助我們學校的科學展。

q.en: The table is not stable because one leg is shorter.
q.zh: 這張桌子不穩，因為有一隻腳比較短。

q.en: The startling noise from the kitchen woke everyone up at midnight.
q.zh: 廚房傳來令人吃驚的聲響，在半夜把大家吵醒了。

q.en: Amy is taking a statistics class because she likes numbers.
q.zh: 艾咪修了一門統計學的課，因為她喜歡數字。

q.en: Mr. Chen's class is stimulating because he asks challenging questions.
q.zh: 陳老師的課很有啟發性，因為他會問具挑戰性的問題。

q.zh: 你可以把冬天的衣服收在床底下。

q.zh: 開始之前，先用尺畫一條直線。

q.zh: 我們的隊伍需要更好的策略來贏得決賽。

q.zh: 這篇文章的結構清楚，很容易讀懂。

q.en: The deadline for submission of the science report is Friday.
q.zh: 科學報告的繳交期限是星期五。

q.zh: 艾咪錯過了公車，後來上學就遲到了。

q.en: The city will subsidize bus fares for students next year.
q.zh: 市政府明年將補貼學生的公車車資。

q.en: Salt is a substance that mixes with water easily.
q.zh: 鹽是一種很容易和水混合的物質。

q.en: Lisa subtly changed the topic when her friends began arguing.
q.zh: 當朋友們開始爭吵時，莉莎巧妙地轉移了話題。

q.en: Kevin's family moved to a quiet suburb of Taichung last year.
q.zh: 凱文一家去年搬到台中一個安靜的郊區。

q.en: Mr. Wu will succeed Mr. Lee as our class advisor next semester.
q.zh: 吳老師下學期將接替李老師擔任我們的導師。

q.en: Grandpa is superstitious and never cuts his nails at night.
q.zh: 爺爺很迷信，晚上從不剪指甲。

q.en: The students worked under the supervision of their science teacher.
q.zh: 學生們在自然老師的監督下進行工作。

q.en: Mr. Lin will supervise the experiment in the science lab.
q.zh: 林老師會在自然實驗室監督這項實驗。

q.en: Mr. Hsu will supervise the students during the field trip.
q.zh: 徐老師會在校外教學期間看管學生。

q.en: Let's suppose that it rains on the day of the picnic.
q.zh: 我們來假設野餐那天會下雨。

q.en: The school announced the suspension of classes because of the typhoon.
q.zh: 學校因颱風宣布停課。

q.en: We should use sustainable energy, such as wind and solar power.
q.zh: 我們應該使用永續能源，例如風力和太陽能。

q.en: Plants need enough water and sunlight to sustain their growth.
q.zh: 植物需要足夠的水和陽光來維持生長。

q.en: The dove is a symbol of peace in many countries.
q.zh: 在許多國家，鴿子是和平的象徵。

q.en: The smell of fried chicken is a big temptation for Ben.
q.zh: 炸雞的香味對班來說是一大誘惑。

q.en: The tempting smell of fresh bread filled the whole street.
q.zh: 令人垂涎的新鮮麵包香氣瀰漫了整條街。

q.en: Lisa was terrified when she heard a strange noise outside.
q.zh: 莉莎聽到外面有奇怪的聲音時嚇壞了。

q.en: The police caught the thief who stole bikes near our school.
q.zh: 警察抓到了在我們學校附近偷腳踏車的小偷。

q.en: Mr. Chen explained the theory of gravity in simple words.
q.zh: 陳老師用簡單的話解釋了重力理論。

q.en: Ben goes to physical therapy twice a week after his injury.
q.zh: 班受傷之後，每週去做兩次物理治療。

q.en: A therapist helped Kevin recover from his leg injury.
q.zh: 治療師協助凱文從腿傷中復原。

q.en: Amy was thrilled to win first prize in the speech contest.
q.zh: 艾咪很興奮能在演講比賽中得到第一名。

q.en: The roller coaster ride gave the children a big thrill.
q.zh: 雲霄飛車讓孩子們感到非常刺激。

q.en: Heat can transform ice into water in a few minutes.
q.zh: 熱可以在幾分鐘內把冰變成水。

q.en: Mosquitoes can transmit serious diseases from one person to another.
q.zh: 蚊子會把嚴重的疾病從一個人傳染給另一個人。

q.en: After a long talk, Kevin ultimately chose to join the chess club.
q.zh: 經過一番長談，凱文最後選擇加入西洋棋社。

q.en: Amy will graduate from senior high school next June.
q.zh: 艾咪明年六月將從高中畢業。

q.en: I have no doubt that Lisa will pass the exam.
q.zh: 我毫不懷疑莉莎會通過考試。

q.zh: 許多失業的工人參加了市政府舉辦的就業博覽會。

q.en: Please fold the paper in half before you cut it.
q.zh: 剪之前請先把紙對摺。

q.en: Remember to lock the classroom door before you leave.
q.zh: 離開前記得把教室的門鎖好。

q.en: Ben vaguely remembered seeing the old man at the night market.
q.zh: 班隱約記得曾在夜市看過那位老先生。

q.en: Sorry, your ticket is invalid because it expired yesterday.
q.zh: 抱歉，你的票已經無效，因為昨天就過期了。

q.en: The price of vegetables can vary a lot from week to week.
q.zh: 蔬菜的價格每週都可能有很大的變動。

q.en: The shop sells various kinds of cheap notebooks and pens.
q.zh: 這家店賣各式各樣便宜的筆記本和筆。

q.en: Mr. Lee verbally warned the students to stop making noise.
q.zh: 李老師口頭警告學生不要再吵鬧。

q.en: From the top of the hill, we had a wonderful view.
q.zh: 從山頂上，我們看到了絕佳的景色。

q.en: The room was virtually empty except for one old chair.
q.zh: 除了一張舊椅子之外，房間幾乎是空的。

q.en: Lisa has a sweet voice and loves singing in the choir.
q.zh: 莉莎有甜美的嗓音，也很愛在合唱團唱歌。

q.en: The volcanic island attracts many tourists every summer.
q.zh: 這座火山島每年夏天都吸引許多遊客。

q.en: Kevin has been acting weirdly since he lost his phone.
q.zh: 凱文自從手機掉了之後，行為就很奇怪。

q.en: Bad news can spread quickly through a small school like ours.
q.zh: 壞消息在像我們這樣的小學校裡會傳得很快。

q.en: We saw many wild animals during our trip to the national park.
q.zh: 我們到國家公園旅行時看到了許多野生動物。

q.en: Many wild birds spend the winter in this quiet wetland.
q.zh: 許多野鳥在這片安靜的濕地過冬。

q.en: Ben's wit makes everyone laugh during lunch break.
q.zh: 班的機智讓大家在午休時間哈哈大笑。

q.en: This old book is worth reading more than once.
q.zh: 這本舊書值得讀不只一遍。

q.en: Is this movie worth watching on a rainy weekend?
q.zh: 這部電影值得在下雨的週末觀看嗎？

q.en: Mr. Chen wrote an abbreviation for the long word on the board.
q.zh: 陳老師把那個長單字的縮寫寫在黑板上。

q.en: Freedom and honesty are abstract ideas that are hard to draw.
q.zh: 自由和誠實是很難畫出來的抽象概念。

q.en: Our island has abundant fruit and fresh seafood all year round.
q.zh: 我們的島上全年都有豐富的水果和新鮮的海產。

q.en: Lisa works hard to keep her academic grades high every semester.
q.zh: 莉莎每學期都很努力維持她的學業成績。

q.en: Amy opened a bank account to save her allowance.
q.zh: 艾咪開了一個銀行帳戶來存她的零用錢。

q.en: The accumulation of dust under the bed made Ben sneeze.
q.zh: 床底下積了一層灰塵，讓班一直打噴嚏。

q.en: Dust will accumulate quickly if you never clean your room.
q.zh: 如果你從不打掃房間，灰塵會很快堆積起來。

q.en: Do not accuse your classmates without clear proof.
q.zh: 沒有明確證據，不要隨便指控你的同學。

q.en: Kevin is not accustomed to waking up at five every morning.
q.zh: 凱文不習慣每天早上五點起床。

q.en: Students need time to adapt to the new school schedule.
q.zh: 學生需要時間來適應新的學校作息。

q.en: Ben is addicted to online games and sleeps too little.
q.zh: 班沉迷於線上遊戲，睡得太少。

q.en: The school administration announced a new rule about cell phones.
q.zh: 學校行政單位宣布了一項關於手機的新規定。

q.en: Many adolescent students feel stressed about exams and friendships.
q.zh: 許多青春期的學生會因為考試和友誼而感到壓力。

q.en: Our class teacher always gives us good advice about studying.
q.zh: 我們的導師總是給我們很好的讀書建議。

q.en: The puppy showed great affection for its young owner.
q.zh: 那隻小狗對牠年幼的主人表現出很深的感情。

q.en: The movie is about an alien who makes friends with a boy.
q.zh: 這部電影是關於一個外星人和一個男孩交朋友的故事。

q.en: The thief allegedly hid the stolen bike behind the school.
q.zh: 據稱那名小偷把偷來的腳踏車藏在學校後面。

q.en: Your answer is ambiguous, so the teacher asked you to explain.
q.zh: 你的答案模稜兩可，所以老師請你說明。

q.en: The singer used an amplifier to make her guitar louder.
q.zh: 那位歌手用擴音器讓她的吉他聲更大。

q.en: Students must analyze the poem and explain its main message.
q.zh: 學生必須分析這首詩並說明它的主旨。

q.en: Amy loves watching animation films with her little brother.
q.zh: 艾咪喜歡和弟弟一起看動畫電影。

q.en: Ben was annoyed because his brother kept using his computer.
q.zh: 班很生氣，因為他弟弟一直在用他的電腦。

q.en: We anticipate that many people will attend the school fair.
q.zh: 我們預期會有很多人來參加校慶園遊會。

q.en: The audience gave the young pianist warm applause.
q.zh: 觀眾給了那位年輕的鋼琴家熱烈的掌聲。

q.en: Kevin wants to apply for the summer English camp.
q.zh: 凱文想申請暑期英語營。

q.en: The trip to the museum takes approximately forty minutes.
q.zh: 到博物館的路程大約要四十分鐘。

q.en: The archaeologist found some old pots in the ground.
q.zh: 那位考古學家在地底下發現了一些舊陶罐。

q.en: Lisa's aspiration is to become a famous doctor someday.
q.zh: 莉莎的抱負是有一天成為著名的醫師。

q.en: Kevin joined the astronomy club to learn about the stars.
q.zh: 凱文加入天文社來認識星星。

q.en: The astronomer used a big telescope to watch the moon.
q.zh: 那位天文學家用大型望遠鏡觀察月亮。

q.en: Hard work is the key to the attainment of your goals.
q.zh: 努力是達成你目標的關鍵。

q.en: Amy must attend the meeting after school on Tuesday.
q.zh: 艾咪星期二放學後必須出席那場會議。

q.en: The students planted flowers to make the school look more beautiful.
q.zh: 學生們種花讓學校看起來更美麗。

q.en: Ben spoke bluntly, so some classmates felt a little hurt by his words.
q.zh: Ben 說話很直率，所以有些同學覺得被他的話傷到了。

q.en: The road is quite broad, so two buses can pass each other easily.
q.zh: 這條路相當寬闊，所以兩輛公車可以輕鬆會車。

q.en: The river is very broad near the sea, and boats can pass easily.
q.zh: 這條河在靠近海的地方很寬闊，船隻可以輕易通過。

q.en: Amy used her calculator to calculate the total cost of the school trip.
q.zh: Amy 用計算機計算這次校外教學的總費用。

q.en: The little bird was kept in captivity for a month before it flew free.
q.zh: 那隻小鳥被關了一個月之後才重獲自由。

q.en: Lisa received a certificate after she finished the first aid course.
q.zh: Lisa 上完急救課程後拿到了一張證書。

q.en: Our class held a bake sale to raise money for a local charity.
q.zh: 我們班舉辦烘焙義賣，為當地一個慈善機構募款。

q.en: Kevin is good at chemistry, and he wants to study it in college.
q.zh: Kevin 很擅長化學，而且他想在大學念這個科目。

q.en: Mr. Chen taught us about the ancient civilization along the Nile River.
q.zh: 陳老師教我們認識尼羅河沿岸的古文明。

q.en: The two bikes will collide at the corner if the riders do not slow down.
q.zh: 如果騎士不減速，兩輛腳踏車會在轉角相撞。

q.en: Good friends should communicate honestly when they have a problem.
q.zh: 好朋友有問題時應該誠實地溝通。

q.en: Ben made a comparison between the two phones before buying one.
q.zh: Ben 買手機前把兩支手機做了比較。

q.en: My English teacher gives us a reading comprehension test every Friday.
q.zh: 我的英文老師每週五都會給我們一次閱讀理解測驗。

q.en: Please answer the question concisely, because we only have five minutes left.
q.zh: 請簡潔地回答這個問題，因為我們只剩五分鐘了。

q.en: The team worked hard to conquer the highest mountain on the island.
q.zh: 這支隊伍努力要征服島上最高的山。

q.en: Lisa joined a club that works for the conservation of sea turtles.
q.zh: Lisa 加入了一個致力於保育海龜的社團。

q.en: It rained continuously for three days, so the baseball game was canceled.
q.zh: 連續下了三天雨，所以棒球比賽被取消了。

q.en: There is a clear contradiction between what he said and what he did.
q.zh: 他說的話和做的事之間有明顯的矛盾。

q.en: The teacher said the story was incredible, but it was actually true.
q.zh: 老師說這個故事令人難以置信，但它其實是真的。

q.en: Small savings accumulate over time if you put money aside every week.
q.zh: 如果你每週存一點錢，小額儲蓄會隨著時間累積。

q.en: Eating dumplings on Lunar New Year is a custom in many families.
q.zh: 在農曆新年吃水餃是許多家庭的習俗。

q.en: When the bus broke down, Mr. Chen acted decisively and called for help.
q.zh: 公車拋錨時，陳老師果斷地採取行動並打電話求助。

q.en: The coach is so dedicated that he trains with us every morning.
q.zh: 教練非常投入，每天早上都和我們一起訓練。

q.en: The shop gave me a new one because the first phone was defective.
q.zh: 店家給了我一支新的，因為第一支手機有瑕疵。

q.en: The plane began to descend slowly as it came close to the airport.
q.zh: 飛機接近機場時開始慢慢下降。

q.en: Some people believe that destiny decides who we will meet in life.
q.zh: 有些人相信命運決定了我們一生會遇見誰。

q.en: My uncle works as a diplomat and has lived in four different countries.
q.zh: 我叔叔是外交官，住過四個不同的國家。

q.en: The typhoon was a terrible disaster for the small fishing village.
q.zh: 那場颱風對這個小漁村來說是一場可怕的災難。

q.en: The company refused to disclose how much money it had lost last year.
q.zh: 那家公司拒絕透露去年虧損了多少錢。

q.en: Loud music can distract students when they are trying to study.
q.zh: 當學生想讀書時，大聲的音樂會使他們分心。

q.en: Please do not disturb your brother while he is taking a nap.
q.zh: 你弟弟在午睡時，請不要打擾他。

q.en: Our school has a diverse group of students from many places.
q.zh: 我們學校有來自許多地方、背景多元的學生。

q.en: The price of vegetables rose drastically after the heavy rain last week.
q.zh: 上週的大雨之後，蔬菜價格大幅上漲。

q.en: Kevin works as an editor for the school newspaper every Thursday afternoon.
q.zh: Kevin 每週四下午為校刊擔任編輯。

q.en: The school reported that enrollment grew by ten percent this year.
q.zh: 學校表示今年的入學人數成長了百分之十。

q.en: Amy gave an excellent speech, and everyone in the hall clapped loudly.
q.zh: Amy 發表了一場精采的演講，禮堂裡每個人都大聲鼓掌。

q.en: Eating an excessive amount of sugar is bad for your teeth and health.
q.zh: 攝取過量的糖對你的牙齒和健康都不好。

q.en: The price does not include tax, so please exclude it from the total.
q.zh: 這個價格不含稅，所以請把稅從總額中排除。

q.en: Check the expiration date on the milk before you drink it.
q.zh: 喝牛奶前先檢查一下保存期限。

q.en: This song sounds familiar, but I cannot remember where I heard it.
q.zh: 這首歌聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起來在哪裡聽過。

q.en: Kevin was fascinated by the stars, so he joined the astronomy club.
q.zh: Kevin 對星星很著迷，所以加入了天文社。

q.en: The land near the river is fertile, so farmers grow rice there.
q.zh: 河邊的土地很肥沃，所以農夫在那裡種稻。

q.en: The garden was full of fragrant flowers after the spring rain.
q.zh: 春雨過後，花園裡開滿了芳香的花朵。

q.en: Lisa searched frantically for her keys because she was late for school.
q.zh: Lisa 因為上學快遲到了，慌亂地找她的鑰匙。

q.en: Mr. Lin was furious when he saw the mess in the classroom.
q.zh: 林老師看到教室一團亂時非常生氣。

q.en: My little sister is a fussy eater and refuses to eat green vegetables.
q.zh: 我妹妹很挑食，不肯吃綠色蔬菜。

q.en: It was a gloomy day, and the dark clouds covered the whole sky.
q.zh: 那是陰沉的一天，烏雲遮住了整片天空。

q.en: I do not like greasy food because it makes my stomach feel heavy.
q.zh: 我不喜歡油膩的食物，因為它讓我的胃感到沉重。

q.en: Some students say the old building behind the gym is haunted.
q.zh: 有些學生說體育館後面的舊大樓鬧鬼。

q.en: The firefighter became a hero after he saved three children from the fire.
q.zh: 那位消防員從火場救出三個孩子後成了英雄。

q.en: The family treated us with warm hospitality when we visited their farm.
q.zh: 我們拜訪他們的農場時，那家人以熱情的款待招呼我們。

q.en: Falling on the stage in front of everyone was a humiliating experience.
q.zh: 在大家面前摔倒在舞台上是一次丟臉的經驗。

q.en: Washing your hands often is a simple and hygienic habit for everyone.
q.zh: 常洗手是人人都該有的簡單又衛生的習慣。

q.en: Some teenagers seem indifferent to the news, but they still care about their friends.
q.zh: 有些青少年對新聞似乎漠不關心，但他們仍然在乎朋友。

q.en: Taiwan has a strong industry that makes computer parts for many countries.
q.zh: 台灣有一個強大的產業，為許多國家製造電腦零件。

q.en: The flu spreads easily, so wash your hands to avoid infection.
q.zh: 流感很容易傳播，所以要洗手以避免感染。

q.en: Only a few families still inhabit this small island in the south.
q.zh: 只有少數幾戶人家還住在南方這座小島上。

q.en: Everyone in class felt it was unjust to blame Amy for the mistake.
q.zh: 全班都覺得因為這個錯誤而責怪 Amy 是不公平的。

q.en: Kevin sent an inquiry to the school office about the summer camp.
q.zh: Kevin 寄了一封詢問暑期營隊的信到學校辦公室。

q.en: Mom will insist that we finish our homework before dinner.
q.zh: 媽媽一定會堅持我們在晚餐前寫完功課。

q.en: Birds build nests by instinct, not because anyone teaches them.
q.zh: 鳥類靠本能築巢，不是因為有人教牠們。

q.en: Mr. Chen is an intellectual person who reads every single day.
q.zh: 陳老師是個很有知識涵養的人，每天都讀書。

q.en: Can you interpret what the teacher said about this poem, Ben?
q.zh: Ben，你可以詮釋一下老師對這首詩說的話嗎？

q.en: The teacher's quick intervention stopped the argument between the two boys.
q.zh: 老師迅速的介入制止了兩個男孩之間的爭吵。

q.en: Amy and Lisa have been intimate friends since elementary school.
q.zh: Amy 和 Lisa 從小學起就是親密的朋友。

q.en: The tall senior looked intimidating, but he was actually very kind.
q.zh: 那個高個子學長看起來很嚇人，但其實人很好。

q.en: Kevin found the movie's ending quite intriguing and talked about it all day.
q.zh: Kevin 覺得那部電影的結局很吸引人，講了一整天。

q.en: Sorry for the intrusion, but may I borrow your pen for a minute?
q.zh: 不好意思打擾了，我可以跟你借一下筆嗎？

q.en: Please do not intrude on others when they are studying in the library.
q.zh: 別人在圖書館讀書時，請不要去打擾他們。

q.en: Teachers help us see the value of hard work.
q.zh: 老師幫助我們看見努力的價值。

q.en: The fastest runner in class was, ironically, late for the race.
q.zh: 班上跑最快的人，諷刺的是，比賽卻遲到了。

q.en: The loud noise next door began to irritate everyone in the classroom.
q.zh: 隔壁的吵鬧聲開始惹惱教室裡的每個人。

q.en: Lisa felt irritation when her little brother kept tapping the table.
q.zh: Lisa 的弟弟一直敲桌子，讓她很惱火。

q.en: We took a ferry to a beautiful island last summer.
q.zh: 我們去年夏天搭渡輪去了一座美麗的島嶼。

q.en: My arms feel itchy after I walk through the tall grass.
q.zh: 我穿過高高的草叢後，手臂覺得很癢。

q.en: The students shouted with joy when they heard the good news.
q.zh: 學生們聽到好消息時開心地大喊。

q.en: Reading widely gives you more knowledge about the world around you.
q.zh: 廣泛閱讀讓你對周遭的世界有更多的認識。

q.en: Our landlord lives downstairs and often gives us fresh fruit.
q.zh: 我們的房東住在樓下，常常送我們新鮮水果。

q.en: The hall was lavishly decorated for the school's anniversary party.
q.zh: 大禮堂為了學校的校慶派對裝飾得很華麗。

q.en: What is the length of this bridge, Mr. Chen?
q.zh: 陳老師，這座橋的長度是多少？

q.en: Everyone should have the liberty to share their own ideas in class.
q.zh: 每個人都應該有在課堂上分享自己想法的自由。

q.en: Our school has a liberal rule about wearing casual clothes on Fridays.
q.zh: 我們學校對星期五穿便服的規定很寬鬆。

q.en: This bag is very light, so even Amy can carry it easily.
q.zh: 這個袋子很輕，連 Amy 都能輕鬆提起來。

q.en: Ben loves reading and wants to study English literature in college.
q.zh: Ben 熱愛閱讀，想在大學念英國文學。

q.en: Don't take his words literally, because Kevin was only joking.
q.zh: 別把他的話照字面解釋，因為 Kevin 只是在開玩笑。

q.en: Our school runs a program to improve students' reading literacy.
q.zh: 我們學校推行一項提升學生閱讀素養的計畫。

q.en: Amy felt lonely after her best friend moved to another city.
q.zh: Amy 的好朋友搬到別的城市後，她覺得很孤單。

q.en: Please speak loudly so everyone at the back can hear you.
q.zh: 請大聲說話，讓後面的人都聽得到。

q.en: Everyone admired the majesty of the mountain at sunrise.
q.zh: 大家都很讚嘆日出時那座山的雄偉。

q.en: We stood in front of the majestic castle and took many photos.
q.zh: 我們站在雄偉的城堡前拍了很多照片。

q.en: Please write your notes in the margin of the page, Ben.
q.zh: Ben，請把筆記寫在頁面的空白處。

q.en: We had a marvelous time on the school trip to Hualien.
q.zh: 我們在花蓮的校外教學玩得非常開心。

q.en: It takes years of practice to master the piano.
q.zh: 要精通鋼琴需要多年的練習。

q.en: The teacher acted as a mediator between Amy and Lisa.
q.zh: 老師在 Amy 和 Lisa 之間擔任調解人。

q.en: Mr. Chen spends ten minutes on meditation every morning before class.
q.zh: 陳老師每天早上上課前花十分鐘冥想。

q.en: Some students meditate for a few minutes before the exam to stay calm.
q.zh: 有些學生考試前會冥想幾分鐘讓自己保持冷靜。

q.en: Good sleep is important for both your mental and physical health.
q.zh: 充足的睡眠對你的心理與身體健康都很重要。

q.en: The merchant at the night market sells cheap but tasty snacks.
q.zh: 夜市裡的那位商人賣便宜又好吃的小吃。

q.en: Many birds migrate to Taiwan to escape the cold winter.
q.zh: 許多鳥類遷徙到臺灣來躲避寒冷的冬天。

q.en: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the small accident.
q.zh: 那場小意外沒有人受傷，真是奇蹟。

q.en: The little boy got into mischief while his mother was cooking.
q.zh: 媽媽在煮飯時，那個小男孩在搗蛋。

q.en: Kevin uses his mobile phone to listen to English podcasts on the bus.
q.zh: Kevin 在公車上用手機聽英語播客。

q.en: The city has built many modern buildings in the past ten years.
q.zh: 這座城市過去十年蓋了許多現代化的建築。

q.en: The modernization of the old train station took two years.
q.zh: 舊火車站的現代化工程花了兩年。

q.en: Lisa saves some of her money every month to buy books.
q.zh: Lisa 每個月存一部分的錢來買書。

q.en: Ben thinks washing dishes is a monotonous job.
q.zh: Ben 覺得洗碗是件單調的工作。

q.en: The kids in the story were afraid of a big green monster.
q.zh: 故事裡的孩子們很怕一隻綠色大怪物。

q.en: Amy is in a good mood because she got a high score.
q.zh: Amy 因為考了高分，心情很好。

q.en: The narrator of this story is a ten-year-old girl.
q.zh: 這個故事的敘述者是一位十歲的女孩。

q.en: Mr. Chen asked Kevin to narrate the story in front of the class.
q.zh: 陳老師請 Kevin 在全班面前敘述這個故事。

q.en: Our national basketball team won an important game last night.
q.zh: 我們的國家籃球隊昨晚贏了一場重要的比賽。

q.en: The phone's navigation app helped us find the way to the museum.
q.zh: 手機的導航應用程式幫我們找到去博物館的路。

q.en: Amy can navigate the busy streets of Taipei without a map.
q.zh: Amy 不用地圖也能在臺北繁忙的街道上找路。

q.en: Many students did well, notably Lisa, who got a perfect score.
q.zh: 許多學生表現不錯，尤其是拿到滿分的 Lisa。

q.en: Fruit and vegetables give your body the nourishment it needs.
q.zh: 水果和蔬菜提供身體所需的營養。

q.en: Students have an obligation to keep the classroom clean.
q.zh: 學生有義務保持教室整潔。

q.en: Kevin is obsessed with basketball and plays it every afternoon.
q.zh: Kevin 迷上籃球，每天下午都在打。

q.en: Strange things sometimes occur during exam week at our school.
q.zh: 考試週期間，我們學校有時會發生怪事。

q.en: Can you operate this machine for me, Ben, without breaking it?
q.zh: Ben，你可以幫我操作這台機器而不弄壞它嗎？

q.en: The heat in the room was so oppressive that we opened the windows.
q.zh: 房間裡悶熱得讓人難受，所以我們打開了窗戶。

q.en: The summer afternoon was hot and oppressive, so we stayed inside.
q.zh: 夏天的午後又熱又悶，所以我們待在室內。

q.en: Please put the books in the right order on the shelf.
q.zh: 請把書依正確的順序放在書架上。

q.en: Amy will organize a birthday party for our classmate on Friday.
q.zh: Amy 星期五要為我們的同學籌辦生日派對。

q.en: Our school holds an orientation for new students in September.
q.zh: 我們學校九月會為新生舉辦迎新活動。

q.en: The original plan was to visit the zoo, but it rained.
q.zh: 原本的計畫是去動物園，但是下雨了。

q.en: Lisa read a story about a kind orphan who loved books.
q.zh: Lisa 讀了一個關於愛書的善良孤兒的故事。

q.en: A large number of students joined the club this year.
q.zh: 今年有大量學生加入這個社團。

q.en: The price of that small cup of tea is outrageous.
q.zh: 那一小杯茶的價格貴得離譜。

q.en: Kevin felt great outrage when someone broke his new bicycle.
q.zh: 有人弄壞他的新腳踏車時，Kevin 非常憤怒。

q.en: Mr. Chen looks tired because he is overworked this week.
q.zh: 陳老師看起來很累，因為他這個星期工作過度。

q.en: Ben began to pack his bag for the school trip.
q.zh: Ben 開始為校外教學打包行李。

q.en: Milk is perishable, so you should keep it in the fridge.
q.zh: 牛奶容易腐壞，所以應該放在冰箱裡。

q.en: You must ask for permission before using the school gym.
q.zh: 使用學校體育館之前必須先徵得許可。

q.en: Amy's perseverance helped her finish the long hike up the mountain.
q.zh: Amy 的毅力幫助她完成了這趟漫長的登山健行。

q.en: If you persist in practicing every day, you will improve.
q.zh: 如果你堅持每天練習，就會進步。

q.en: Lisa's persistence finally helped her win the speech contest.
q.zh: Lisa 的堅持終於讓她贏得演講比賽。

q.en: Kevin bought some medicine at the pharmacy near the station.
q.zh: Kevin 在車站附近的藥局買了一些藥。

q.en: The pharmacist told Amy to take the pills after meals.
q.zh: 藥劑師告訴 Amy 飯後吃藥。

q.en: Lisa has practiced the piano for ten years.
q.zh: Lisa 已經練習鋼琴十年了。

q.en: Mr. Chen likes to plant tomatoes on the school roof.
q.zh: 陳老師喜歡在學校屋頂種番茄。

q.en: Our class will put on a play at the school festival.
q.zh: 我們班要在校慶上演出一齣戲。

q.en: Taiwan has a large population in a small area.
q.zh: 臺灣在一小塊土地上有龐大的人口。

q.en: Please give me the precise time of the meeting, Lisa.
q.zh: Lisa，請告訴我會議的確切時間。

q.en: Ben enjoys reading books about the history of Taiwan.
q.zh: Ben 喜歡讀關於臺灣歷史的書。

q.en: Amy was chosen as the president of the student council.
q.zh: Amy 被選為學生會的會長。

q.en: Kevin dreams of studying at a prestigious university.
q.zh: Kevin 夢想就讀一所名校。

q.en: Washing your hands often can prevent many kinds of illness.
q.zh: 常洗手可以預防許多疾病。

q.en: What is the price of this notebook, Lisa?
q.zh: Lisa，這本筆記本的價格是多少？

q.en: Everyone needs some privacy in their own bedroom.
q.zh: 每個人在自己的臥室裡都需要一些隱私。

q.en: We can proceed to the next question after Amy finishes this one.
q.zh: Amy 做完這題後，我們就可以繼續下一題。

q.en: Lisa is proficient in both English and Japanese.
q.zh: Lisa 精通英語和日語。

q.en: School rules prohibit students from using phones during class.
q.zh: 校規禁止學生在上課時使用手機。

q.en: The prospect of a long holiday made everyone in class excited.
q.zh: 即將有長假的前景讓全班都很興奮。

q.en: "Shandong is a large province in northern China," said Mr. Chen.
q.zh: 陳老師說山東是中國北方的一個大省。

q.en: Amy wants to study psychology at university and help teenagers.
q.zh: Amy 想在大學念心理學並幫助青少年。

q.en: The new library is open to the public every day.
q.zh: 新圖書館每天都對大眾開放。

q.en: Please arrive punctually, because the bus leaves at seven.
q.zh: 請準時抵達，因為公車七點就開。

q.en: This mountain stream near our school has very pure water.
q.zh: 學校附近這條山間溪流的水非常純淨。

q.en: We use a filter to purify the water in our school.
q.zh: 我們學校用濾水器淨化水。

q.en: Lisa studied hard to qualify for the national speech contest.
q.zh: Lisa 努力用功，要取得全國演講比賽的資格。

q.en: Amy didn't realize it was raining until she left school.
q.zh: Amy 直到離開學校才發現在下雨。

q.en: Don't ride your bike recklessly on the busy street.
q.zh: 不要在繁忙的街上魯莽地騎腳踏車。

q.en: Swimming is a popular form of recreation at our school.
q.zh: 游泳是我們學校很受歡迎的休閒活動。

q.en: Please refer to page ten for the answer, class.
q.zh: 各位同學，請參考第十頁的答案。

q.en: Lisa has a refined taste in music and loves classical pieces.
q.zh: Lisa 的音樂品味很高雅，喜愛古典樂曲。

q.en: The lake can reflect the mountains like a mirror.
q.zh: 湖面能像鏡子一樣倒映出群山。

q.en: A cold shower on a hot day is very refreshing.
q.zh: 大熱天沖個冷水澡讓人精神一振。

q.en: A short walk can refresh your mind after a long study session.
q.zh: 長時間讀書後散個步可以讓你的頭腦恢復精神。

q.en: After the injury, Ben did rehabilitation exercises for two months.
q.zh: 受傷後，Ben 做了兩個月的復健運動。

q.en: We have a rehearsal for the school play after class today.
q.zh: 我們今天下課後要為校園話劇排練。

q.en: Amy is a reliable friend who always keeps her promises.
q.zh: Amy 是個可靠的朋友，總是遵守承諾。

q.en: You can rely on Kevin to finish the group report on time.
q.zh: 你可以信賴 Kevin 會準時完成小組報告。

q.en: Only ten minutes remain before the exam begins.
q.zh: 離考試開始只剩十分鐘了。

q.en: Please remind me to bring my umbrella tomorrow, Amy.
q.zh: Amy，請提醒我明天帶雨傘。

q.en: Ben felt resentful when his brother took his seat again.
q.zh: Ben 的弟弟又佔了他的位子，他覺得很不高興。

q.en: Every resident in this building must keep the stairs clear.
q.zh: 這棟大樓的每位住戶都必須保持樓梯暢通。

q.en: It is hard to resist the smell of fried chicken at night markets.
q.zh: 很難抗拒夜市炸雞的香味。

q.en: We should respect our teachers and listen carefully in class.
q.zh: 我們應該尊敬老師並在課堂上專心聽講。

q.en: The workers will restore the old house next year.
q.zh: 工人們明年會修復那棟老房子。

q.en: Lisa didn't want to reveal the secret of her birthday gift.
q.zh: Lisa 不想透露她生日禮物的祕密。

q.en: A cup of hot tea can revive you after a long walk.
q.zh: 走了很長的路後，一杯熱茶可以讓你恢復元氣。

q.en: The revival of the old market made the street lively again.
q.zh: 老市場的復興讓這條街再度熱鬧起來。

q.en: The Earth completes one revolution around the sun every year.
q.zh: 地球每年繞太陽公轉一圈。

q.en: Ben is Kevin's rival in the math contest, but they are friends.
q.zh: Ben 是 Kevin 在數學競賽中的對手，但他們是朋友。

q.en: The rotation of the Earth gives us day and night.
q.zh: 地球的自轉帶來白天與黑夜。

q.en: The wheel began to rotate slowly when the wind blew.
q.zh: 風一吹，輪子就開始慢慢轉動。

q.en: Tourists lined up to visit the royal palace in London.
q.zh: 遊客排隊參觀倫敦的皇宮。

q.en: Wash your hands to keep the kitchen clean and sanitary.
q.zh: 洗手能讓廚房保持乾淨衛生。

q.en: Kevin took photos of the beautiful scenery along the mountain road.
q.zh: Kevin 在山路沿途拍了許多美麗風景的照片。

q.en: Amy took a picture of the stone sculpture in the park.
q.zh: Amy 拍了公園裡那座石雕的照片。

q.en: Please select one answer for each question, class.
q.zh: 各位同學，每題請選一個答案。

q.en: Ben watched the whole series of science films last weekend.
q.zh: Ben 上週末看完了整個科學影片系列。

q.en: Amy will serve tea to the guests at the party.
q.zh: Amy 會在派對上為客人奉茶。

q.en: Be careful with that sharp knife when you cut the apples, Kevin.
q.zh: Kevin，切蘋果時小心那把鋒利的刀子。

q.en: The teacher explained the rule in simple words.
q.zh: 老師用簡單的話解釋這條規則。

q.en: Amy likes the simplicity of this recipe because it takes ten minutes.
q.zh: Amy 喜歡這份食譜的簡單，因為只要十分鐘。

q.en: Lisa tried to cook and answer the phone simultaneously.
q.zh: Lisa 試著同時煮飯和接電話。

q.en: Lisa is very social and makes friends easily at every school event.
q.zh: Lisa 很善於交際，在每場學校活動都很容易交到朋友。

q.en: Our society needs more people who are willing to help others.
q.zh: 我們的社會需要更多願意幫助別人的人。

q.en: Joining a club is a good way to practice social skills.
q.zh: 加入社團是練習社交技巧的好方法。

q.en: Technology has changed our society in many ways.
q.zh: 科技在許多方面改變了我們的社會。

q.en: The principal spoke solemnly about the importance of honesty at the ceremony.
q.zh: 校長在典禮上莊嚴地談到誠實的重要。

q.en: After a busy week, Amy enjoys the solitude of her quiet room.
q.zh: 忙碌一週後，Amy 很享受獨自待在安靜房間裡的時光。

q.en: Kevin took a solitary walk along the river after the exam.
q.zh: 考完試後，Kevin 獨自沿著河邊散步。

q.en: The soothing music helped Lisa relax after a long day.
q.zh: 舒緩的音樂幫助 Lisa 在漫長的一天後放鬆。

q.en: Ben felt great sorrow when his old dog passed away.
q.zh: Ben 的老狗過世時，他感到非常悲傷。

q.en: Every country should have the right to protect its sovereignty.
q.zh: 每個國家都應有權保護自己的主權。

q.en: The fireworks over the river were truly spectacular last night.
q.zh: 昨晚河面上的煙火真的非常壯觀。

q.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from the hotel.
q.zh: 我們從旅館可以欣賞到壯麗的山景。

q.en: The crowd spontaneously began to sing when the team won.
q.zh: 球隊獲勝時，群眾自發地唱起歌來。

q.en: Mr. Chen taught us that sportsmanship is more important than winning.
q.zh: 陳老師教我們運動家精神比贏球更重要。

q.en: Kevin is a fair sportsman who always shakes hands after games.
q.zh: Kevin 是個公平的運動員，比賽後總是會握手。

q.en: The doctor said Ben's condition is now stable after the surgery.
q.zh: 醫生說 Ben 手術後的狀況現在很穩定。

q.en: Many animals starve in winter when food is hard to find.
q.zh: 許多動物在冬天找不到食物時會挨餓。

q.en: Reading interesting books can stimulate young children's imagination and creativity.
q.zh: 閱讀有趣的書可以刺激小孩的想像力與創造力。

q.en: Lisa wore a stunning dress to the school dance.
q.zh: Lisa 穿了一件極漂亮的洋裝參加學校舞會。

q.en: Amy has her own style when it comes to clothes.
q.zh: 談到衣服，Amy 有自己的風格。

q.en: A good news report should be objective rather than based on feelings.
q.zh: 好的新聞報導應該客觀，而不是憑感覺。

q.en: Lisa pays a monthly subscription to watch her favorite shows online.
q.zh: Lisa 每月付訂閱費在線上看她最愛的節目。

q.en: Ben decided to subscribe to a science magazine this year.
q.zh: Ben 今年決定訂閱一本科學雜誌。

q.en: The government gives a subsidy to farmers who grow rice.
q.zh: 政府提供補貼給種稻的農民。

q.en: Our team won five successive games and reached the finals.
q.zh: 我們的球隊連贏五場比賽，晉級決賽。

q.en: Our team lost three games in succession before finally winning.
q.zh: 我們的球隊連輸三場後終於贏了。

q.en: Ben's grades are superior to those of most students in his class.
q.zh: Ben 的成績比班上大多數同學都好。

q.en: Some people believe in superstition and avoid the number four.
q.zh: 有些人相信迷信，避開數字四。

q.en: Dr. Lin performed surgery on Amy's grandfather last week.
q.zh: 林醫師上週為 Amy 的爺爺動了手術。

q.en: The school will suspend classes if the typhoon gets stronger.
q.zh: 如果颱風增強，學校將停課。

q.en: The teacher had to suspend the game because of the heavy rain.
q.zh: 因為下大雨，老師必須暫停比賽。

q.en: The dove is a symbol of peace in many countries.
q.zh: 在許多國家，鴿子是和平的象徵。

q.en: The two sides of the butterfly's wings are perfectly symmetrical.
q.zh: 蝴蝶兩邊的翅膀完全對稱。

q.en: Lisa felt great sympathy for the lost child at the station.
q.zh: Lisa 對車站裡走失的孩子感到十分同情。

q.en: The meeting is tentatively scheduled for next Friday afternoon.
q.zh: 會議暫定在下週五下午舉行。

q.en: The long hike was tiring, but the view was worth it.
q.zh: 這趟長途健行很累人，但風景很值得。

q.en: A strong signal is needed for the transmission of clear pictures.
q.zh: 要傳送清晰的畫面需要強的訊號。

q.en: The children found a box of treasure at the beach.
q.zh: 孩子們在海灘上發現一箱寶藏。

q.en: Don't worry about such a trifling mistake, Amy.
q.zh: 別擔心這種小錯誤，Amy。

q.en: Taiwan has a warm climate and many tropical fruits.
q.zh: 台灣氣候溫暖，有許多熱帶水果。

q.en: The class voted unanimously to hold the party on Friday.
q.zh: 全班一致投票決定星期五辦派對。

q.en: Mom said I can go out, but on one condition.
q.zh: 媽媽說我可以出去，但有一個條件。

q.en: Ben tried to estimate how long the homework would take him.
q.zh: Ben 試著估計作業要花他多久時間。

q.en: The coach tried to unify the team before the big game.
q.zh: 教練在大賽前努力讓球隊團結一致。

q.en: Strong unity helped our class win the sports day trophy.
q.zh: 強大的團結力幫助我們班贏得運動會獎盃。

q.en: Please call Dr. Lin back because it is an urgent matter.
q.zh: 請回電給林醫師，因為這是緊急的事。

q.en: The movie was utterly boring, so we left early.
q.zh: 那部電影無聊透頂，所以我們提早離開。

q.en: Every student must get a vaccination before entering the school.
q.zh: 每位學生入學前都必須接種疫苗。

q.en: Lisa is too vain to leave home without looking in the mirror.
q.zh: Lisa 太愛漂亮，出門前一定要照鏡子。

q.en: Water will evaporate quickly under the hot summer sun.
q.zh: 水在夏天的烈日下會很快蒸發。

q.en: Everyone admires Amy's versatility in music, sports, and art.
q.zh: 大家都欣賞 Amy 在音樂、運動和美術上的多才多藝。

q.en: Kevin felt the vibration of the train through his feet.
q.zh: Kevin 用腳感受到火車的振動。

q.en: My phone began to vibrate during the English class.
q.zh: 上英文課時，我的手機開始震動。

q.en: Our class won a great victory in the basketball game.
q.zh: 我們班在籃球賽中贏得了大勝利。

q.en: Ben shook the bottle vigorously before opening it.
q.zh: Ben 在打開瓶子前用力搖了搖。

q.en: The old man is full of vigor, even at the age of eighty.
q.zh: 那位老先生即使八十歲了仍然充滿活力。

q.en: Amy practices the violin for one hour every day.
q.zh: Amy 每天練習一小時小提琴。

q.en: Water is vital to every living thing on Earth.
q.zh: 水對地球上每個生物都至關重要。

q.en: Ben plans to attend a vocational high school to learn cooking.
q.zh: Ben 打算讀高職學烹飪。

q.en: Teaching is not just a job but a vocation for Mr. Chen.
q.zh: 對陳老師來說，教書不只是工作，更是一份使命。

q.en: The laptop is still under warranty, so the repair is free.
q.zh: 這台筆電還在保固期內，所以維修免費。

q.en: Kevin sat down wearily after the long hike.
q.zh: 長途健行後，Kevin 疲倦地坐了下來。

q.en: Mom ironed my wrinkled shirt before the school photo day.
q.zh: 媽媽在學校拍照日前幫我燙平皺掉的襯衫。

q.en: Please follow the rules when using the library.
q.zh: 使用圖書館時請遵守規定。

q.en: This dictionary is very useful for learning new words.
q.zh: 這本字典對學新單字非常有用。

q.en: The founder of our school was a famous teacher.
q.zh: 我們學校的創辦人是一位有名的老師。

q.en: Put the leftover food into a plastic container, Amy.
q.zh: Amy，把剩菜放進塑膠容器裡。

q.en: Lisa likes chemistry because the experiments are fun.
q.zh: Lisa 喜歡化學，因為實驗很有趣。

q.en: The new method is very effective for learning vocabulary.
q.zh: 這個新方法對學單字非常有效。

q.en: Amy's kind words gave Kevin a lot of encouragement before the contest.
q.zh: Amy 親切的話在比賽前給了 Kevin 很大的鼓勵。

q.en: Kevin is able to solve the math problem in one minute.
q.zh: Kevin 能在一分鐘內解出這道數學題。

q.en: Amy has a rich imagination and writes wonderful stories.
q.zh: Amy 想像力豐富，寫出很棒的故事。

q.en: Our class made a proposal to change the lunch menu.
q.zh: 我們班提出了更改午餐菜單的提案。

q.zh: 大家都喜歡麗莎，因為她的個性溫暖又友善。

q.zh: 大家都對凱文畫的校門感到驚訝。

q.zh: 尖峰時間市區塞車幾乎是無法避免的。

q.en: Amy hopes to fly to Japan with her family next summer.
q.zh: 小艾希望明年夏天和家人搭飛機去日本。

q.en: Water is necessary for the survival of all living things.

q.zh: 常洗手可以防止感染擴散。

q.zh: 麗莎是個有創意的女孩，會自己做衣服。

q.zh: 長時間的籃球賽後，凱文完全累壞了。

q.zh: 一大群人聚集在體育場外觀看比賽。

q.en: We should recycle bottles and cans instead of throwing them away.
q.zh: 我們應該回收瓶罐，而不是把它們丟掉。

q.zh: 麗莎加入了環保社團來保護當地的河川。

q.zh: 吃一頓像樣的早餐能幫助學生在課堂上保持清醒。

q.zh: 我們學校的學生可以自由選擇自己的社團。

q.en: Amy has a firm belief that hard work pays off.
q.zh: 小艾堅信努力就會有回報。

q.en: Everyone in our class cares about fairness when we choose team leaders.
q.zh: 我們班上每個人在選組長時都很在意公平。

q.zh: 醫生會用一些藥來治療凱文的喉嚨痛。

q.zh: 請留著收據，以防你想退這雙鞋。

q.zh: 小艾的包包和我的很像，但顏色不同。

q.zh: 舞者毫不費力地在舞台上移動。

q.zh: 這家店的每位顧客都能得到一杯免費的茶。

q.zh: 這枚舊硬幣對阿班的爺爺來說很有價值。

q.zh: 小艾很在意自己的外表，尤其是頭髮。

q.zh: 那輛壞掉的腳踏車必須修好，阿班才能騎。

q.zh: 小艾的父母非常支持她成為廚師的夢想。

q.zh: 我們應該尊重老師和同學。

q.zh: 麗莎，請按下紅色按鈕來啟動機器。

q.zh: 阿班今天早上到學校時，一切看起來都很正常。

q.zh: 睡眠不足對你的成績有不好的影響。

q.zh: 小艾對好朋友送的禮物感到很高興。

q.zh: 麗莎不太願意在全校面前演講。

q.zh: 凱文在日記裡詳細描述了他的校外旅行。

q.zh: 陳老師為我們清楚地解釋了那道數學題。

q.zh: 天氣冷的早晨，小艾很難早起。

q.zh: 陳老師把零食平均分給所有學生。

q.zh: 小艾得流感後很快就康復了。

q.zh: 這是真皮包，不是廉價的仿製品。

q.zh: 小艾現在買不起新手機。

q.zh: 暴風雨讓整個海邊小鎮一片殘破。

q.zh: 陳老師打開投影機，開始上課。

q.zh: 夏天要常喝水，才不會脫水。

q.en: The rules of the new game are too complex for me to understand.
q.zh: 這個新遊戲的規則對我來說太複雜，我看不懂。

q.en: Mr. Chen explained the rule plainly so everyone understood.
q.zh: 陳老師把規則解釋得很清楚，所以大家都懂了。

q.en: Sunlight can hardly penetrate the thick forest on the mountain.
q.zh: 陽光幾乎無法穿透濃密的森林。

q.en: Lisa made a decision to join the swimming team.
q.zh: 麗莎決定加入游泳隊。

q.en: No one can compel you to join a club you don't like.
q.zh: 沒有人能強迫你加入你不喜歡的社團。

q.en: The old teacher still likes to use conventional methods in class.
q.zh: 那位年長的老師上課仍喜歡用傳統的方法。

q.en: Can you give me the definition of this word, Mr. Chen?
q.zh: 陳老師，可以告訴我這個字的定義嗎？

q.en: Don't let the cover of the book mislead you about its story.
q.zh: 別讓書的封面誤導你對故事內容的想像。

q.en: Mr. Chen found a flaw in Ben's math solution.
q.zh: 陳老師在阿班的數學解法中找到一個錯誤。

q.en: Your student card is valid until the end of next year.
q.zh: 你的學生證到明年年底前都有效。

q.en: The website needs verification of your email address first.
q.zh: 網站需要先驗證你的電子郵件地址。

q.en: Ben wants to sail around Taiwan on a small boat someday.
q.zh: 阿班希望有一天能駕小船環島航行。

q.en: Lisa saved a considerable amount of money for the trip.
q.zh: 麗莎為了這趟旅行存了相當多的錢。

q.en: A dense fog covered the mountain road this morning.
q.zh: 今天早上濃霧籠罩了山路。

q.en: It is not ethical to copy other students' homework.
q.zh: 抄襲其他同學的作業是不道德的。

q.en: Amy's parents are concerned about her health during the exam week.
q.zh: 小艾的父母很擔心她在考試週期間的健康。

q.en: Eye color is genetic, so Amy has brown eyes like her parents.
q.zh: 眼睛的顏色是遺傳的，所以小艾和她父母一樣有棕色的眼睛。

q.en: Ben has been very tired lately because of the exams.
q.zh: 阿班最近因為考試而非常疲倦。

q.en: This movie is not suitable for young children.
q.zh: 這部電影不適合小朋友看。

q.en: Amy enjoys the tranquility of the library after school.
q.zh: 小艾喜歡放學後圖書館的寧靜。

q.en: Lisa loves reading literature in her free time.
q.zh: 麗莎空閒時喜歡閱讀文學作品。

q.en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor, Kevin.
q.zh: 凱文，搭電梯到五樓。

q.en: A small incident happened in the cafeteria at lunchtime.
q.zh: 午餐時間餐廳裡發生了一件小事故。

q.en: Most students use a mobile phone to check the bus schedule.
q.zh: 大多數學生用手機查公車時刻表。

q.en: Amy gave an eloquent speech at the graduation ceremony.
q.zh: 小艾在畢業典禮上發表了一場很有說服力的演講。
